events/os-lusiadas-event-05-053/notes.pt: Estrofe 53; O gigante recorda-se de Doris levar a sua demanda a Tétis e devolver a sua resposta.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-055/descript.source: Adamastor tells of approaching what seems to be Thetis in the dark.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-055/descript.pt: Adamastor conta que se aproximou do que parece ser Tétis no escuro.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-055/notes.source: Stanza 55; Adamastor approaches an apparent Thetis that proves to be an illusion.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-055/notes.pt: Estrofe 55; Adamastor aproxima-se de uma aparente Tétis que se revela uma ilusão.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-056/descript.source: Adamastor discovers rock in his arms and recalls his bodily transformation.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-056/descript.pt: Adamastor descobre pedra nos braços e recorda a sua transformação corporal.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-056/notes.source: Stanza 56; The giant finds stone in its arms and tells of being fixed into a headland.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-056/notes.pt: Estrofe 56; O gigante encontra uma pedra nos braços e conta-lhe que foi fixado num promontório.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-056/title.pt: Pedra em vez de uma ninfa

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-060/descript.source: The giant vanishes and Gama prays that its threatened disasters be averted.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-060/descript.pt: O gigante desaparece e Gama reza para que os desastres ameaçados sejam evitados.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-060/notes.source: Stanza 60; The apparition vanishes and Gama prays against the foretold harm.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-060/notes.pt: Estrofe 60; A aparição desaparece e Gama reza contra o mal previsto.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-061/descript.source: After Adamastor disappears, the fleet continues around southern Africa and makes further landfalls.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-061/descript.pt: Após o desaparecimento do Adamastor, a frota continua em redor da África Austral e faz mais desembarques.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-061/notes.source: Stanza 61; The fleet rounds the headland and continues along the southern coast.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-061/notes.pt: Estrofe 61; A frota contorna o promontório e continua ao longo da costa sul.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-062/descript.source: A coastal community greets the sailors with music and trade.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-062/descript.pt: Uma comunidade costeira saúda os marinheiros com música e comércio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-062/notes.source: Stanza 62; A different coastal group welcomes trade with the sailors.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-062/notes.pt: Estrofe 62; Um grupo costeiro diferente acolhe o comércio com os marinheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-065/descript.source: The ships leave the welcoming shore and press through difficult currents.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-065/descript.pt: Os navios deixam a costa acolhedora e atravessam correntes difíceis.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-065/notes.source: Stanza 65; The fleet leaves the trading shore and struggles against a current.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-065/notes.pt: Estrofe 65; A frota deixa a costa comercial e luta contra a corrente.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-068/descript.source: The voyagers enter a river on the Christian feast and seek water and provisions.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-068/descript.pt: Os viajantes entram num rio na festa cristã e procuram água e provisões.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-068/notes.source: Stanza 68; The ships enter a river on the feast of Epiphany for water and provisions.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-068/notes.pt: Estrofe 68; Os navios entram num rio na festa da Epifania em busca de água e provisões.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-070/descript.source: Gama recalls difficult coastal travel and the threat of further hostile encounters.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-070/descript.pt: Gama recorda as difíceis viagens costeiras e a ameaça de novos encontros hostis.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-070/notes.source: Stanza 70; The company is exhausted by hunger, weather, and poor food.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-070/notes.pt: Estrofe 70; A empresa está exausta pela fome, pelo clima e pela má alimentação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-075/descript.source: The voyagers seek information and a place to halt on the East African coast.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-075/descript.pt: Os viajantes procuram informações e um local de paragem na costa leste africana.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-075/notes.source: Stanza 75; Sailors meet people with seafaring knowledge at another river.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-075/notes.pt: Estrofe 75; Os marinheiros encontram pessoas com conhecimentos marítimos noutro rio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-077/descript.source: Fernão Martins understands local speech and brings news of traders and people farther east.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-077/descript.pt: Fernão Martins compreende o discurso local e traz notícias de comerciantes e gentes mais a leste.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-077/notes.source: Stanza 77; Fernão Martins interprets news offered by people near the river.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-077/notes.pt: Estrofe 77; Fernão Martins interpreta notícias oferecidas por pessoas junto ao rio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-078/descript.source: The crew marks its hopeful river stop and raises a stone marker.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-078/descript.pt: A tripulação marca a sua esperançosa paragem no rio e ergue uma lápide de pedra.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-078/notes.source: Stanza 78; The company names the river for its hopeful signs and raises a stone marker.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-078/notes.pt: Estrofe 78; A empresa dá nome ao rio pelos seus sinais de esperança e ergue uma lápide de pedra.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-081/descript.source: Scurvy kills sailors as Gama continues toward a safer harbor.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-081/descript.pt: O escorbuto mata marinheiros enquanto Gama segue em direção a um porto mais seguro.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-081/notes.source: Stanza 81; Scurvy kills sailors during the river stay.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-081/notes.pt: Estrofe 81; O escorbuto mata os marinheiros durante a estadia no rio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-084/descript.source: Gama carries the route account through the harbors already known to his listener.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-084/descript.pt: Gama faz o relato do percurso pelos portos já conhecidos do seu ouvinte.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-084/notes.source: Stanza 84; Gama’s remembered route reaches Mozambique and Mombasa.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-084/notes.pt: Estrofe 84; A recordada rota do Gama chega a Moçambique e Mombaça.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-085/descript.source: Gama closes the account at the harbor where he is speaking.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-085/descript.pt: Gama fecha a conta no porto onde fala.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-085/notes.source: Stanza 85; The retrospective arrives at the Melinde meeting itself.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-085/notes.pt: Estrofe 85; A retrospetiva chega ao próprio encontro de Melinde.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-090/descript.source: The king and his company respond to Gama’s account before the poet takes up the value of praise.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-090/descript.pt: O rei e a sua companhia respondem ao relato de Gama antes de o poeta assumir o valor do elogio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-090/notes.source: Stanza 90; The ruler praises the completed account and the listeners respond.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-090/notes.pt: Estrofe 90; O governante elogia o relato concluído e os ouvintes respondem.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-092/descript.source: The poet reflects on the place of learning and song beside heroic action.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-092/descript.pt: O poeta reflete sobre o lugar da aprendizagem e do canto ao lado da ação heróica.

events/os-lusiadas-event-05-092/notes.source: Stanza 92; The poet reflects on praise after the account has ended.
events/os-lusiadas-event-05-092/notes.pt: Estrofe 92; O poeta reflete sobre o elogio após o término do relato.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-001/descript.source: Melinde’s ruler honors the voyagers as they make ready to cross toward India.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-001/descript.pt: O governante de Melinde presta homenagem aos viajantes enquanto se preparam para atravessar em direção à Índia.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-001/notes.source: Stanza 1; The ruler and Gama part as the fleet prepares for the crossing.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-001/notes.pt: Estrofe 1; O governante e Gama separam-se enquanto a frota se prepara para a travessia.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-006/descript.source: Angered by the ships’ progress, Bacchus travels to Neptune’s realm.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-006/descript.pt: Irritado com o progresso das naves, Baco viaja até ao reino de Neptuno.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-006/notes.source: Stanza 6; Bacchus descends beneath the sea after seeing the fleet progress.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-006/notes.pt: Estrofe 6; Baco desce ao fundo do mar depois de ver o progresso da frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-006/title.pt: Baco vai para o fundo do mar

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-014/descript.source: Bacchus meets Neptune and asks for the powers of the sea to be summoned.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-014/descript.pt: Baco encontra Neptuno e pede que os poderes do mar sejam convocados.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-014/notes.source: Stanza 14; Neptune receives Bacchus and hears his request for a council.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-014/notes.pt: Estrofe 14; Neptuno recebe Baco e ouve o seu pedido de conselho.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-016/descript.source: Neptune sends Triton to gather the powers of the sea for counsel.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-016/descript.pt: Neptuno envia Tritão para reunir os poderes do mar em busca de conselhos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-016/notes.source: Stanza 16; Neptune orders Triton to summon the sea powers.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-016/notes.pt: Estrofe 16; Neptuno ordena a Tritão que convoque as potências marítimas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-016/title.pt: Neptuno convoca os deuses do mar

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-020/descript.source: Oceanus, Nereus, Proteus, and other sea powers arrive for counsel.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-020/descript.pt: Oceano, Nereu, Proteu e outras potências marítimas chegam para aconselhamento.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-020/notes.source: Stanza 20; Proteus joins the assembly while other sea figures take their places.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-020/notes.pt: Estrofe 20; Proteu junta-se à assembleia enquanto outras figuras do mar tomam os seus lugares.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-021/descript.source: Neptune’s consort comes to the council as the sea powers settle.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-021/descript.pt: A consorte de Neptuno chega ao conselho enquanto as potências marítimas se estabelecem.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-021/notes.source: Stanza 21; Neptune’s unnamed consort arrives among the sea powers.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-021/notes.pt: Estrofe 21; A consorte anónima de Neptuno chega entre as potências marítimas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-022/descript.source: The poem names Neptune’s consort as Amphitrite.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-022/descript.pt: O poema nomeia a consorte de Neptuno como Anfitrite.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-022/notes.source: Stanza 22; The consort is named Amphitrite as the assembly settles.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-022/notes.pt: Estrofe 22; O consorte é nomeado Anfitrite quando a assembleia se instala.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-026/descript.source: Bacchus argues that human voyages threaten the sea gods’ standing.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-026/descript.pt: Baco defende que as viagens humanas ameaçam a posição dos deuses do mar.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-026/notes.source: Stanza 26; Bacchus addresses the gathered sea powers against the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-026/notes.pt: Estrofe 26; Baco dirige-se às potências marítimas reunidas contra a frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-035/descript.source: The council sends Neptune’s order to release opposing winds.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-035/descript.pt: O conselho envia a ordem de Neptuno para libertar ventos opostos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-035/notes.source: Stanza 35; The council sends an order to Aeolus to strike the ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-035/notes.pt: Estrofe 35; O conselho envia uma ordem a Éolo para atacar os navios.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-036/descript.source: Proteus tries to speak, but Thetis tells him to accept Neptune’s decision.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-036/descript.pt: Proteu tenta falar, mas Tétis diz-lhe para aceitar a decisão de Neptuno.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-036/notes.source: Stanza 36; Proteus tries to speak but Thetis stops him.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-036/notes.pt: Estrofe 36; Proteu tenta falar, mas Tétis impede-o.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-037/descript.source: Aeolus lets the winds loose against the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-037/descript.pt: Éolo solta os ventos contra a frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-037/notes.source: Stanza 37; Aeolus opens the winds against the approaching ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-037/notes.pt: Estrofe 37; Éolo abre os ventos contra os navios que se aproximam.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-038/descript.source: The ships sail quietly at night while one watch rests and another takes its place.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-038/descript.pt: Os navios navegam tranquilamente à noite enquanto um vigia descansa e outro toma o seu lugar.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-038/notes.source: Stanza 38; The shipboard watches change as the fleet sails unaware of the council.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-038/notes.pt: Estrofe 38; O navio observa a mudança enquanto a frota navega sem saber do conselho.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-040/descript.source: One sailor suggests a story of love to keep the watch alert.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-040/descript.pt: Um marinheiro sugere uma história de amor para manter o relógio alerta.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-040/notes.source: Stanza 40; Leonardo proposes a love story to keep the watch awake.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-040/notes.pt: Estrofe 40; Leonardo propõe uma história de amor para manter o relógio acordado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-041/descript.source: Veloso rejects a love story and offers a martial one.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-041/descript.pt: Veloso rejeita uma história de amor e oferece uma história marcial.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-041/notes.source: Stanza 41; Veloso rejects Leonardo’s subject and offers a tale of combat.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-041/notes.pt: Estrofe 41; Veloso rejeita o tema de Leonardo e conta uma história de combate.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-042/descript.source: Veloso names the subject of the tale he will tell.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-042/descript.pt: Veloso nomeia o tema da história que vai contar.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-042/notes.source: Stanza 42; Veloso announces the Twelve of England to the listening sailors.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-042/notes.pt: Estrofe 42; Veloso anuncia os Doze de Inglaterra aos marinheiros ouvintes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-043/descript.source: Veloso places the tale in England during John’s reign in Portugal.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-043/descript.pt: Veloso situa a história em Inglaterra durante o reinado de João em Portugal.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-043/notes.source: Stanza 43; The tale sets its courtly conflict in England during John’s reign.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-043/notes.pt: Estrofe 43; A história situa o seu conflito cortês em Inglaterra durante o reinado de João.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-044/descript.source: Courtiers question the honor of ladies in the English court.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-044/descript.pt: Os cortesãos questionam a honra das senhoras na corte inglesa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-044/notes.source: Stanza 44; English courtiers challenge the honor of unnamed court ladies.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-044/notes.pt: Estrofe 44; Os cortesãos ingleses desafiam a honra das damas da corte não identificadas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-046/descript.source: The women seek help from the Duke of Lancaster.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-046/descript.pt: As mulheres procuram a ajuda do duque de Lencastre.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-046/notes.source: Stanza 46; The women turn to the Duke of Lancaster for support.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-046/notes.pt: Estrofe 46; As mulheres recorrem ao duque de Lencastre em busca de apoio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-050/descript.source: The women receive Portuguese champions, who prepare to answer the challenge.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-050/descript.pt: As mulheres recebem campeãs portuguesas, que se preparam para responder ao desafio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-050/notes.source: Stanza 50; The duke chooses twelve Portuguese defenders for the ladies.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-050/notes.pt: Estrofe 50; O duque escolhe doze defensores portugueses para as senhoras.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-051/descript.source: A messenger delivers the request to the Portuguese court.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-051/descript.pt: Um mensageiro entrega o pedido ao tribunal português.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-051/notes.source: Stanza 51; The king hears the request but cannot personally enter the contest.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-051/notes.pt: Estrofe 51; O rei ouve o pedido, mas não pode participar pessoalmente na competição.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-053/descript.source: Magriço separates from the other defenders to travel overland.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-053/descript.pt: Magriço separa-se dos restantes defensores para viajar por terra.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-053/notes.source: Stanza 53; Magriço asks to separate from the company and go overland.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-053/notes.pt: Estrofe 53; Magriço pede para se separar da empresa e seguir por terra.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-056/descript.source: Magriço heads overland while eleven companions cross by sea.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-056/descript.pt: Magriço segue por terra enquanto onze companheiros atravessam por mar.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-056/notes.source: Stanza 56; Magriço sets out by land while the other champions take ship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-056/notes.pt: Estrofe 56; Magriço parte por terra enquanto os outros campeões embarcam.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-058/descript.source: The defenders prepare for the contest before the English court.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-058/descript.pt: Os defensores preparam-se para a disputa perante a corte inglesa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-058/notes.source: Stanza 58; The court prepares for the appointed contest.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-058/notes.pt: Estrofe 58; O tribunal prepara-se para o concurso designado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-059/descript.source: The woman assigned to Magriço waits as the contest approaches.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-059/descript.pt: A mulher atribuída ao Magriço aguarda a aproximação do concurso.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-059/notes.source: Stanza 59; The lady assigned to Magriço has no champion yet on the field.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-059/notes.pt: Estrofe 59; A senhora designada para Magriço ainda não tem campeã em campo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-060/descript.source: The English king and court watch the Portuguese defenders face their opponents.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-060/descript.pt: O rei e a corte ingleses observam os defensores portugueses a enfrentar os seus adversários.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-060/notes.source: Stanza 60; The English king sits before the contest while one lady lacks a defender.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-060/notes.pt: Estrofe 60; O rei inglês senta-se perante a disputa enquanto uma senhora não tem defensor.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-062/descript.source: Magriço reaches the field and restores the missing champion.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-062/descript.pt: Magriço chega ao campo e recupera o campeão desaparecido.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-062/notes.source: Stanza 62; Magriço reaches the field and speaks before joining his fellows.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-062/notes.pt: Estrofe 62; Magriço chega ao campo e fala antes de se juntar aos companheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-063/descript.source: The last lady dons her colors and the champions charge.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-063/descript.pt: A última dama veste as suas cores e os campeões atacam.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-063/notes.source: Stanza 63; The lady takes heart and Magriço joins the charging champions.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-063/notes.pt: Estrofe 63; A senhora anima-se e Magriço junta-se aos campeões da investida.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-067/descript.source: The duke and ladies receive the victors with celebrations.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-067/descript.pt: O duque e as damas recebem os vencedores com celebrações.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-067/notes.source: Stanza 67; The duke and ladies welcome the victors after the combat.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-067/notes.pt: Estrofe 67; O duque e as damas dão as boas-vindas aos vencedores após o combate.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-068/descript.source: Magriço stays in Flanders for another challenge.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-068/descript.pt: Magriço fica na Flandres para mais um desafio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-068/notes.source: Stanza 68; Magriço remains in Flanders and takes another challenge.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-068/notes.pt: Estrofe 68; Magriço permanece na Flandres e aceita mais um desafio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-069/descript.source: Veloso starts another knightly episode before the watch interrupts him.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-069/descript.pt: Veloso inicia outro episódio cavalheiresco antes de o relógio o interromper.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-069/notes.source: Stanza 69; Veloso begins another knightly episode before the weather cuts him off.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-069/notes.pt: Estrofe 69; Veloso inicia outro episódio de cavalaria antes que o tempo o interrompa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-070/descript.source: The ship’s master sees danger in the weather and calls the sailors to work as wind and sea bear down.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-070/descript.pt: O comandante do navio vê perigo no tempo e chama os marinheiros para trabalhar enquanto o vento e o mar estão fortes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-070/notes.source: Stanza 70; The ship’s master warns of rising wind and orders sail reduced.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-070/notes.pt: Estrofe 70; O comandante do navio alerta para o aumento do vento e para as ordens de navegação reduzidas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-075/descript.source: Paulo’s vessel loses its mast while Coelho’s ship also faces the storm.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-075/descript.pt: A embarcação de Paulo perde o mastro enquanto a de Coelho também enfrenta a tempestade.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-075/notes.source: Stanza 75; Paulo’s mast breaks and Nicolau’s vessel faces the same storm.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-075/notes.pt: Estrofe 75; O mastro de Paulo parte-se e a embarcação de Nicolau enfrenta a mesma tempestade.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-080/descript.source: With the fleet near destruction, Gama appeals for help.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-080/descript.pt: Com a frota quase destruída, Gama pede ajuda.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-080/notes.source: Stanza 80; Gama sees the fleet near destruction and prays for help.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-080/notes.pt: Estrofe 80; Gama vê a frota perto da destruição e reza por ajuda.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-085/descript.source: Venus sends the nymphs to quiet the contending winds and spare the ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-085/descript.pt: Vénus envia as ninfas para acalmar os ventos rivais e poupar os navios.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-085/notes.source: Stanza 85; Venus descends toward the storm to protect the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-085/notes.pt: Estrofe 85; Vénus desce em direção à tempestade para proteger a frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-088/descript.source: The wind gods relent under the nymphs’ appeal.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-088/descript.pt: Os deuses do vento cederam ao apelo das ninfas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-088/notes.source: Stanza 88; Orithyia addresses Boreas while Venus directs the intervention.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-088/notes.pt: Estrofe 88; Orithyia dirige-se a Bóreas enquanto Vénus dirige a intervenção.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-090/descript.source: Galatea asks the southern wind to quiet itself for the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-090/descript.pt: Galateia pede ao vento sul que se acalme para a frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-090/notes.source: Stanza 90; Galatea urges Notus to moderate his force.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-090/notes.pt: Estrofe 90; Galatea insta Noto a moderar a sua força.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-091/descript.source: The winds pledge to ease their force for the rest of the passage.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-091/descript.pt: Os ventos prometem diminuir a sua força durante o resto da passagem.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-091/notes.source: Stanza 91; The winds pledge a calmer passage to Venus.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-091/notes.pt: Estrofe 91; Os ventos prometem uma passagem mais calma para Vénus.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-092/descript.source: At morning the pilot points out the coast near Calicut to the surviving crew.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-092/descript.pt: De manhã, o piloto aponta a costa perto de Calecute à tripulação sobrevivente.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-092/notes.source: Stanza 92; The pilot identifies land near Calicut after the storm.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-092/notes.pt: Estrofe 92; O piloto identifica terreno perto de Calecute após a tempestade.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-093/descript.source: The captain recognizes the landfall and kneels in gratitude.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-093/descript.pt: O capitão reconhece o desembarque e ajoelha-se em agradecimento.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-093/notes.source: Stanza 93; Gama hears the identification and kneels in gratitude.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-093/notes.pt: Estrofe 93; Gama ouve a identificação e ajoelha-se em agradecimento.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-095/descript.source: The poet weighs peril and labor against the honor sought by the voyagers.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-095/descript.pt: O poeta compara o perigo e o trabalho com a honra procurada pelos viajantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-06-095/notes.source: Stanza 95; The poet reflects on the effort and peril behind honor.
events/os-lusiadas-event-06-095/notes.pt: Estrofe 95; O poeta reflete sobre o esforço e o perigo que está por detrás da honra.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-001/descript.source: The sailors see the land they have sought at the end of the ocean crossing.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-001/descript.pt: Os marinheiros veem a terra que procuravam no final da travessia oceânica.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-001/notes.source: Stanza 1; The fleet reaches the Indian coast recognized by its pilot.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-001/notes.pt: Estrofe 1; A frota chega à costa indiana reconhecida pelo seu piloto.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-002/descript.source: The poet turns from the landfall to an exhortation about the choices of his countrymen.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-002/descript.pt: O poeta passa do desembarque para uma exortação sobre as escolhas dos seus compatriotas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-002/notes.source: Stanza 2; The poet addresses Portuguese readers about their choices and conflicts.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-002/notes.pt: Estrofe 2; O poeta dirige-se aos leitores portugueses sobre as suas escolhas e conflitos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-016/descript.source: Fishing boats guide the fleet along the Malabar coast toward Calicut.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-016/descript.pt: Os barcos de pesca guiam a frota ao longo da costa do Malabar em direção a Calecute.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-016/notes.source: Stanza 16; Fishing boats direct the fleet toward Calicut.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-016/notes.pt: Estrofe 16; Os barcos de pesca encaminham a frota para Calecute.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-022/descript.source: The coastal survey identifies the title held by Calicut’s ruler.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-022/descript.pt: O levantamento costeiro identifica o título do governante de Calecute.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-022/notes.source: Stanza 22; The coastal survey names the ruler of Calicut; he is not directly present on the ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-022/notes.pt: Estrofe 22; O levantamento costeiro nomeia o governante de Calecute; não está diretamente presente nos navios.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-023/descript.source: A Portuguese envoy enters the harbor to announce the ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-023/descript.pt: Um enviado português entra no porto para anunciar os navios.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-023/notes.source: Stanza 23; A Portuguese envoy crosses into the harbor with news of the ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-023/notes.pt: Estrofe 23; Um enviado português chega ao porto com notícias dos navios.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-024/descript.source: A North African Muslim resident approaches the newcomers and recognizes their homeland.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-024/descript.pt: Um residente muçulmano do Norte de África aproxima-se dos recém-chegados e reconhece a sua terra natal.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-024/notes.source: Stanza 24; A resident from Berberia approaches the messenger and recognizes Portugal.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-024/notes.pt: Estrofe 24; Um residente da Berbéria aproxima-se do mensageiro e reconhece Portugal.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-026/descript.source: The local resident gives his name and offers guidance.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-026/descript.pt: O habitante local informa o seu nome e oferece orientações.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-026/notes.source: Stanza 26; The resident names himself Monçaide and offers the envoy shelter.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-026/notes.pt: Estrofe 26; O morador chama-se Monçaide e oferece abrigo ao enviado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-028/descript.source: The messenger and Monçaide come back to the flagship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-028/descript.pt: O mensageiro e Monçaide regressam à nau capitânia.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-028/notes.source: Stanza 28; The two men return to the anchored flagship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-028/notes.pt: Estrofe 28; Os dois homens regressam à nau capitânia ancorada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-029/descript.source: Gama asks the visitor to explain the land and its people.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-029/descript.pt: Gama pede ao visitante que lhe explique a terra e as suas gentes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-029/notes.source: Stanza 29; Gama welcomes Monçaide and asks about the surrounding country.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-029/notes.pt: Estrofe 29; Gama dá as boas-vindas a Monçaide e pergunta-lhe sobre o país envolvente.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-029/title.pt: Gama dá as boas-vindas a Monçaide

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-030/descript.source: The visitor and the Portuguese ask one another how the fleet reached India and what sort of country it has found.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-030/descript.pt: O visitante e os portugueses perguntam-se como é que a frota chegou à Índia e que tipo de país encontrou.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-030/notes.source: Stanza 30; Monçaide explains India and local custom to the captain.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-030/notes.pt: Estrofe 30; Monçaide explica a Índia e os costumes locais ao capitão.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-042/descript.source: The ruler sends for Gama while the city talks about the arrivals.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-042/descript.pt: O governante manda chamar Gama enquanto a cidade fala das chegadas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-042/notes.source: Stanza 42; A summons from the local ruler interrupts the extended explanation.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-042/notes.pt: Estrofe 42; Uma convocação do governante local interrompe a extensa explicação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-043/descript.source: Gama crosses from the ships with Portuguese companions.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-043/descript.pt: Gama atravessa desde os navios com companheiros portugueses.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-043/notes.source: Stanza 43; Gama leaves the ships with Portuguese companions for the shore audience.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-043/notes.pt: Estrofe 43; Gama sai dos navios com companheiros portugueses para o público em terra.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-044/descript.source: Gama lands and is met by the local governor, who conducts him through the city.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-044/descript.pt: Gama desembarca e é recebido pelo governador local, que o conduz pela cidade.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-044/notes.source: Stanza 44; The Catual receives Gama on the beach and guides him inland.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-044/notes.pt: Estrofe 44; O Catual recebe Gama na praia e guia-o para o interior.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-046/descript.source: Gama and the Catual enter a local temple while Monçaide interprets.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-046/descript.pt: Gama e o Catual entram num templo local enquanto Monçaide interpreta.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-046/notes.source: Stanza 46; Monçaide interprets as Gama and the Catual enter a local shrine.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-046/notes.pt: Estrofe 46; Monçaide interpreta a forma como Gama e o Catual entram num santuário local.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-049/descript.source: After a religious stop, Gama proceeds through crowds toward the ruler’s residence.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-049/descript.pt: Após uma paragem religiosa, Gama segue por entre a multidão em direção à residência do governante.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-049/notes.source: Stanza 49; The party leaves the shrine and moves through a growing crowd.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-049/notes.pt: Estrofe 49; A festa sai do santuário e passa por uma multidão crescente.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-050/descript.source: The party approaches the royal residence through its grounds.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-050/descript.pt: O grupo aproxima-se da residência real através dos seus terrenos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-050/notes.source: Stanza 50; The approach reaches gardens and the ruler’s residence.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-050/notes.pt: Estrofe 50; A abordagem chega aos jardins e à residência do governante.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-055/descript.source: The Catual tells Gama what local diviners have said about strangers to come.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-055/descript.pt: O Catual conta ao Gama o que os adivinhos locais disseram sobre os estranhos que viriam.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-055/notes.source: Stanza 55; The Catual voices a prediction about strangers to come.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-055/notes.pt: Estrofe 55; O Catual faz uma previsão sobre estranhos que virão.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-057/descript.source: Gama enters the room where the ruler waits.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-057/descript.pt: Gama entra na sala onde o governante aguarda.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-057/notes.source: Stanza 57; Gama enters the chamber of the ruler whose title was disclosed in the coastal survey.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-057/notes.pt: Estrofe 57; Gama entra na câmara do governante cujo título foi divulgado no levantamento costeiro.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-059/descript.source: Gama presents his king’s message and asks for commerce and amity.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-059/descript.pt: Gama apresenta a mensagem do seu rei e pede comércio e amizade.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-059/notes.source: Stanza 59; Gama speaks to the Samorim about his king and desired friendship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-059/notes.pt: Estrofe 59; Gama fala ao Samorim sobre o seu rei e a desejada amizade.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-064/descript.source: The ruler replies that he will seek counsel before deciding.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-064/descript.pt: O governante responde que procurará aconselhamento antes de decidir.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-064/notes.source: Stanza 64; The ruler postpones a final answer while seeking counsel.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-064/notes.pt: Estrofe 64; O governante adia uma resposta final enquanto procura conselho.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-065/descript.source: The ruler defers an answer, and Gama and his companions rest under local hospitality.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-065/descript.pt: O governante adia uma resposta e Gama e os seus companheiros descansam sob a hospitalidade local.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-065/notes.source: Stanza 65; The audience closes as the ruler offers the visitors rest.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-065/notes.pt: Estrofe 65; A plateia fecha enquanto o governante oferece descanso aos visitantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-066/descript.source: The visitors spend the night at the Catual’s residence.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-066/descript.pt: Os visitantes pernoitam na residência do Catual.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-066/notes.source: Stanza 66; The Catual hosts Gama and the Portuguese party overnight.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-066/notes.pt: Estrofe 66; O Catual recebe o Gama e a festa portuguesa durante a noite.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-067/descript.source: The Catual seeks a fuller account of the Portuguese from the resident who can explain them.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-067/descript.pt: O Catual procura um relato mais completo dos portugueses junto do residente que os possa explicar.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-067/notes.source: Stanza 67; The Catual calls Monçaide to question him about the newcomers.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-067/notes.pt: Estrofe 67; O Catual liga a Monçaide para o questionar sobre os recém-chegados.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-073/descript.source: The Catual visits the ships, where Paulo da Gama receives him and shows him painted banners.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-073/descript.pt: O Catual visita os navios, onde Paulo da Gama o recebe e lhe mostra bandeiras pintadas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-073/notes.source: Stanza 73; Paulo receives the Catual and Monçaide aboard the flagship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-073/notes.pt: Estrofe 73; Paulo recebe o Catual e o Monçaide a bordo do navio-chefe.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-074/descript.source: The visitor studies painted scenes on the flagship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-074/descript.pt: O visitante estuda cenas pintadas na nau capitânia.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-074/notes.source: Stanza 74; The visitors examine painted banners on the Portuguese ship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-074/notes.pt: Estrofe 74; Os visitantes examinam os estandartes pintados do navio português.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-075/descript.source: Paulo welcomes the visitor aboard while he studies the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-075/descript.pt: Paulo recebe o visitante a bordo enquanto estuda a frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-075/notes.source: Stanza 75; Paulo offers the visitor refreshments as the inspection continues.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-075/notes.pt: Estrofe 75; Paulo oferece refrescos ao visitante enquanto a fiscalização continua.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-077/descript.source: Paulo, Coelho, and Monçaide stand with the Catual before painted figures.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-077/descript.pt: Paulo, Coelho e Monçaide acompanham o Catual diante de figuras pintadas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-077/notes.source: Stanza 77; The company gathers before a painted figure and asks who it represents.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-077/notes.pt: Estrofe 77; A companhia reúne-se diante de uma figura pintada e pergunta-lhe quem representa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-078/descript.source: The poet interrupts the narration to ask the nymphs of the Tagus and Mondego for strength.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-078/descript.pt: O poeta interrompe a narração para pedir força às ninfas do Tejo e do Mondego.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-078/notes.source: Stanza 78; The poet turns to the Tagus and Mondego nymphs for renewed strength.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-078/notes.pt: Estrofe 78; O poeta recorre às ninfas do Tejo e do Mondego em busca de forças renovadas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-083/descript.source: The poet reflects on poverty, patronage, and the hardship of those who seek lasting renown.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-083/descript.pt: O poeta reflete sobre a pobreza, o patrocínio e as dificuldades daqueles que procuram uma fama duradoura.

events/os-lusiadas-event-07-083/notes.source: Stanza 83; The poet reflects on the hardship of sustaining the song.
events/os-lusiadas-event-07-083/notes.pt: Estrofe 83; O poeta reflete sobre a dificuldade de sustentar a canção.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-001/descript.source: Paulo da Gama begins explaining the painted ancestors and founders to the Catual.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-001/descript.pt: Paulo da Gama começa a explicar ao Catual os antepassados e fundadores pintados.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-001/notes.source: Stanza 1; Paulo explains painted figures while Monçaide interprets for the Catual.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-001/notes.pt: Estrofe 1; Paulo explica figuras pintadas enquanto Monçaide interpreta para o Catual.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-010/descript.source: The Catual asks about figures of war, and Paulo’s explanation moves among the first rulers.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-010/descript.pt: O Catual pergunta sobre figuras da guerra, e a explicação de Paulo transita entre os primeiros governantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-010/notes.source: Stanza 10; The Catual asks Paulo about the earliest rulers depicted on the banners.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-010/notes.pt: Estrofe 10; O Catual pergunta a Paulo sobre os primeiros governantes retratados nas faixas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-020/descript.source: Paulo identifies defenders remembered for victories and captured standards.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-020/descript.pt: Paulo identifica defensores recordados pelas vitórias e estandartes conquistados.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-020/notes.source: Stanza 20; Paulo moves to images of warriors and captured standards.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-020/notes.pt: Estrofe 20; Paulo passa para imagens de guerreiros e estandartes capturados.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-025/descript.source: The painted record turns to commanders and struggles for southern towns.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-025/descript.pt: O registo pintado volta-se para os comandantes e luta pelas cidades do sul.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-025/notes.source: Stanza 25; The shipboard explanation turns to southern campaigns.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-025/notes.pt: Estrofe 25; A explicação a bordo volta-se para as campanhas no sul.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-035/descript.source: The Catual hears of Portuguese fighters remembered for resisting larger forces.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-035/descript.pt: O Catual ouve falar de combatentes portugueses recordados por resistirem a forças maiores.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-035/notes.source: Stanza 35; The Catual hears of small bands standing against larger forces.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-035/notes.pt: Estrofe 35; O Catual ouve falar de pequenos bandos que se opõem a forças maiores.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-040/descript.source: Paulo brings the exhibition toward its end while judging the deeds represented.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-040/descript.pt: Paulo encerra a exposição ao julgar os feitos representados.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-040/notes.source: Stanza 40; Paulo closes his account of the painted record.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-040/notes.pt: Estrofe 40; Paulo termina o seu relato do disco pintado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-040/title.source: The limits of the painted record

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-044/descript.source: The Catual and his attendants leave the ships as night comes.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-044/descript.pt: O Catual e os seus acompanhantes abandonam os navios ao cair da noite.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-044/notes.source: Stanza 44; The Catual and shore party leave the Portuguese ship at dusk.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-044/notes.pt: Estrofe 44; O Catual e o grupo em terra abandonam o navio português ao entardecer.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-045/descript.source: Diviners and religious advisers study the foreign arrivals for the Samorim.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-045/descript.pt: Adivinhos e conselheiros religiosos estudam as chegadas estrangeiras para o Samorim.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-045/notes.source: Stanza 45; Diviners examine signs about the arrivals under royal order.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-045/notes.pt: Estrofe 45; Os adivinhos examinam os sinais sobre as chegadas sob ordem real.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-046/descript.source: An interpreter of omens tells the ruler what he fears for the region.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-046/descript.pt: Um intérprete de presságios conta ao governante o que teme pela região.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-046/notes.source: Stanza 46; A diviner reports a fearful reading to the Samorim.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-046/notes.pt: Estrofe 46; Um adivinho relata uma leitura assustadora ao Samorim.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-047/descript.source: Bacchus appears to a local religious figure and urges opposition to the Portuguese.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-047/descript.pt: Baco aparece a uma figura religiosa local e insta à oposição aos portugueses.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-047/notes.source: Stanza 47; Bacchus enters a Muslim cleric’s dream in a borrowed guise.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-047/notes.pt: Estrofe 47; Baco entra no sonho de um clérigo muçulmano com uma aparência emprestada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-051/descript.source: The sleeper wakes and summons others to plan a response.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-051/descript.pt: O dorminhoco acorda e convoca outros para planear uma resposta.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-051/notes.source: Stanza 51; The dreamer wakes and convenes others to resist the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-051/notes.pt: Estrofe 51; O sonhador acorda e convoca outros para resistir à frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-052/descript.source: The opponents choose influence and deception as their means.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-052/descript.pt: Os opositores escolhem a influência e o engano como meios.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-052/notes.source: Stanza 52; A local opposition chooses bribery and deceptive claims.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-052/notes.pt: Estrofe 52; Uma oposição local opta pelo suborno e por alegações enganosas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-053/descript.source: Gifts and false claims bring local officials into opposition.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-053/descript.pt: Os presentes e as alegações falsas colocam as autoridades locais na oposição.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-053/notes.source: Stanza 53; Unnamed officials receive gifts while hostile stories are spread; the Catual is not yet identified.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-053/notes.pt: Estrofe 53; Funcionários não identificados recebem presentes enquanto histórias hostis são espalhadas; o Catual ainda não foi identificado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-054/descript.source: The poet reflects on how rulers depend on the honesty of advisers.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-054/descript.pt: O poeta reflete sobre a forma como os governantes dependem da honestidade dos conselheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-054/notes.source: Stanza 54; The poet reflects on a ruler’s dependence on advisers.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-054/notes.pt: Estrofe 54; O poeta reflete sobre a dependência de um governante em relação aos conselheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-057/descript.source: Gama resolves to return to the ruler for a decision.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-057/descript.pt: Gama decide voltar ao governante para uma decisão.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-057/notes.source: Stanza 57; Gama seeks a response to the embassy after growing obstruction.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-057/notes.pt: Estrofe 57; Gama procura resposta à embaixada após crescente obstrução.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-058/descript.source: The ruler has heard hostile reports before Gama arrives.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-058/descript.pt: O governante ouviu relatos hostis antes da chegada de Gama.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-058/notes.source: Stanza 58; The ruler hears accusations about the visitors.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-058/notes.pt: Estrofe 58; O governante ouve acusações sobre os visitantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-059/descript.source: The ruler balances fear of the newcomers against the prospect of trade.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-059/descript.pt: O governante equilibra o medo dos recém-chegados com a perspectiva de comércio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-059/notes.source: Stanza 59; The ruler weighs fear against the value of commerce.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-059/notes.pt: Estrofe 59; O governante compara o medo com o valor do comércio.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-060/descript.source: The ruler summons Gama and asks for an honest account.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-060/descript.pt: O governante convoca Gama e pede um relato honesto.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-060/notes.source: Stanza 60; The ruler summons Gama and demands a direct answer.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-060/notes.pt: Estrofe 60; O governante convoca Gama e exige uma resposta direta.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-061/descript.source: The ruler repeats claims that the captain has invented his embassy.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-061/descript.pt: O governante repete afirmações de que o capitão inventou a sua embaixada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-061/notes.source: Stanza 61; The ruler repeats the claim that Gama has invented his embassy.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-061/notes.pt: Estrofe 61; O governante repete a afirmação de que Gama inventou a sua embaixada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-064/descript.source: Gama replies to the accusations and sets out why the Portuguese have come.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-064/descript.pt: Gama responde às acusações e explica porque vieram os portugueses.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-064/notes.source: Stanza 64; Gama defends his king and voyage against the accusation.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-064/notes.pt: Estrofe 64; Gama defende o seu rei e a sua viagem contra a acusação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-076/descript.source: The ruler weighs Gama’s defense and gives it credence.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-076/descript.pt: O governante avalia a defesa de Gama e dá-lhe crédito.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-076/notes.source: Stanza 76; The ruler finds Gama’s account credible.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-076/notes.pt: Estrofe 76; O governante considera o relato de Gama credível.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-078/descript.source: After permission to trade, Gama leaves the court and asks for transport to the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-078/descript.pt: Após autorização para comercializar, Gama sai da quadra e pede transporte para a frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-078/notes.source: Stanza 78; Gama leaves the audience and seeks a boat from the official.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-078/notes.pt: Estrofe 78; Gama sai da plateia e procura um barco junto do oficial.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-079/descript.source: The Catual withholds a boat and presses Gama to bring the fleet closer to shore.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-079/descript.pt: O Catual retém um barco e pressiona Gama para que a frota se aproxime da costa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-079/notes.source: Stanza 79; The Catual delays Gama’s departure despite the royal permission.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-079/notes.pt: Estrofe 79; O Catual atrasa a saída do Gama apesar da autorização real.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-080/descript.source: The delays make Gama suspect the Catual’s purpose.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-080/descript.pt: Os atrasos fazem com que Gama desconfie do propósito do Catual.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-080/notes.source: Stanza 80; Gama recognizes the delay as a possible trap.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-080/notes.pt: Estrofe 80; Gama reconhece o atraso como uma possível armadilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-081/descript.source: The poem identifies the official’s place in the opposition to the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-081/descript.pt: O poema identifica o lugar do oficial na oposição à frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-081/notes.source: Stanza 81; The Catual’s corrupt role in the opposition is disclosed.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-081/notes.pt: Estrofe 81; O papel corrupto do Catual na oposição é divulgado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-085/descript.source: The Catual insists that the fleet come close to shore.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-085/descript.pt: O Catual insiste para que a frota se aproxime da costa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-085/notes.source: Stanza 85; The Catual demands that the fleet move within reach of shore.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-085/notes.pt: Estrofe 85; O Catual exige que a frota se mova ao alcance da costa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-086/descript.source: Gama recognizes the danger of drawing his ships in and refuses.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-086/descript.pt: Gama reconhece o perigo de atrair os seus navios e recusa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-086/notes.source: Stanza 86; Gama refuses to endanger the vessels to secure his own release.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-086/notes.pt: Estrofe 86; Gama recusa-se a pôr em perigo os navios para garantir a sua própria libertação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-090/descript.source: Gama refuses to risk the ships while the Catual keeps him under pressure.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-090/descript.pt: Gama recusa-se a arriscar os navios enquanto o Catual o mantém sob pressão.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-090/notes.source: Stanza 90; The standoff continues and Gama remains detained.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-090/notes.pt: Estrofe 90; O impasse continua e Gama continua detido.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-091/descript.source: Gama spends the night detained before another offer arrives.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-091/descript.pt: Gama passa a noite detido antes que chegue outra oferta.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-091/notes.source: Stanza 91; Gama remains under guard overnight.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-091/notes.pt: Estrofe 91; Gama permanece sob vigilância durante a noite.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-092/descript.source: The Catual demands merchandise as the price of Gama’s departure.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-092/descript.pt: O Catual exige mercadoria como preço da saída do Gama.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-092/notes.source: Stanza 92; The Catual demands cargo as an alternate price for release.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-092/notes.pt: Estrofe 92; O Catual exige carga como preço alternativo para a sua libertação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-093/descript.source: Gama accepts the exchange and sends for goods from the ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-093/descript.pt: Gama aceita a troca e envia mercadorias dos navios.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-093/notes.source: Stanza 93; Gama arranges to have merchandise sent from the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-093/notes.pt: Estrofe 93; A Gama providencia o envio de mercadorias da frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-094/descript.source: Portuguese goods come ashore, and the Catual releases Gama while two factors remain to sell them.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-094/descript.pt: As mercadorias portuguesas desembarcam e o Catual liberta o Gama, restando dois factores para as vender.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-094/notes.source: Stanza 94; The Catual receives the goods and two named factors remain with them.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-094/notes.pt: Estrofe 94; O Catual recebe a mercadoria e com ela permanecem dois fatores nomeados.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-095/descript.source: Gama returns to the ships after the Catual accepts the goods.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-095/descript.pt: Gama regressa aos navios após o Catual aceitar a mercadoria.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-095/notes.source: Stanza 95; Gama reaches his ships and stays aboard after release.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-095/notes.pt: Estrofe 95; Gama chega aos seus navios e permanece a bordo após ser libertado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-096/descript.source: Back aboard, Gama waits for news as the poet reflects on the sway of money.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-096/descript.pt: De regresso a bordo, Gama aguarda notícias enquanto o poeta reflete sobre a influência do dinheiro.

events/os-lusiadas-event-08-096/notes.source: Stanza 96; The captain remains aboard as the poet reflects on profit.
events/os-lusiadas-event-08-096/notes.pt: Estrofe 96; O capitão permanece a bordo enquanto o poeta reflete sobre o lucro.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-001/descript.source: The Portuguese factors wait in Calicut while local merchants withhold trade and delay their return.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-001/descript.pt: Os factores portugueses aguardam em Calecute enquanto os comerciantes locais retêm o comércio e atrasam o seu regresso.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-001/notes.source: Stanza 1; The factors remain ashore while merchants refuse to buy their goods.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-001/notes.pt: Estrofe 1; Os factores permanecem em terra enquanto os comerciantes se recusam a comprar os seus produtos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-001/title.pt: Os fatores não podem deixar de

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-002/descript.source: The poem explains the trading fleet the opponents expect to arrive.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-002/descript.pt: O poema explica a frota comercial que os opositores esperam que chegue.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-002/notes.source: Stanza 2; The poem explains the Red Sea trade connection behind the delay.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-002/notes.pt: Estrofe 2; O poema explica a ligação comercial do Mar Vermelho por detrás do atraso.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-002/title.source: Ships expected from the Red Sea

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-003/descript.source: The poem names Jeddah as the port from which the trading ships sail.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-003/descript.pt: O poema nomeia Jeddah como o porto de onde partem os navios mercantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-003/notes.source: Stanza 3; Jeddah is named as the departure port for the expected trading ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-003/notes.pt: Estrofe 3; Jeddah é apontada como o porto de partida dos esperados navios mercantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-005/descript.source: Monçaide begins to care for the safety of the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-005/descript.pt: Monçaide começa a zelar pela segurança da frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-005/notes.source: Stanza 5; Monçaide’s concern for the Portuguese begins to overcome his ties to their opponents.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-005/notes.pt: Estrofe 5; A preocupação de Monçaide com os portugueses começa a sobrepor-se aos laços com os adversários.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-005/title.pt: A mudança de opinião de Monçaide

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-006/descript.source: Monçaide hears how the merchants intend to use the expected ships.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-006/descript.pt: Monçaide fica a saber como os mercadores pretendem utilizar os esperados navios.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-006/notes.source: Stanza 6; Monçaide learns the plan to hold the fleet until ships from the Red Sea arrive.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-006/notes.pt: Estrofe 6; Monçaide fica a saber do plano de segurar a frota até à chegada dos navios do Mar Vermelho.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-007/descript.source: Monçaide tells Gama about the expected armed vessels.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-007/descript.pt: Monçaide conta a Gama sobre as embarcações armadas esperadas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-007/notes.source: Stanza 7; Monçaide carries the warning to Gama aboard the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-007/notes.pt: Estrofe 7; Monçaide leva o aviso ao Gama a bordo da frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-008/descript.source: Gama sends for the Portuguese factors to return quietly.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-008/descript.pt: Gama manda que os fatores portugueses regressem tranquilos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-008/notes.source: Stanza 8; Gama quietly orders the factors to return from the city.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-008/notes.pt: Estrofe 8; Gama ordena discretamente aos agentes que regressem da cidade.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-009/descript.source: Gama detains visiting merchants as leverage after hearing that his factors have been held.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-009/descript.pt: Gama detém comerciantes visitantes como forma de vantagem depois de ouvir que os seus pontos foram detidos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-009/notes.source: Stanza 9; On hearing the factors are detained, Gama seizes visiting merchants.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-009/notes.pt: Estrofe 9; Ao saber que os agentes estão detidos, Gama apreende os comerciantes visitantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-010/descript.source: The fleet begins to leave while the merchants remain captive.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-010/descript.pt: A frota começa a partir enquanto os mercadores permanecem cativos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-010/notes.source: Stanza 10; The fleet raises anchors with the merchants held aboard.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-010/notes.pt: Estrofe 10; A frota levanta âncoras com os mercadores mantidos a bordo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-011/descript.source: Relatives of the detained merchants ask the Samorim to intervene.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-011/descript.pt: Familiares dos comerciantes detidos pedem intervenção do Samorim.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-011/notes.source: Stanza 11; Families of the captive merchants petition the ruler.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-011/notes.pt: Estrofe 11; As famílias dos comerciantes cativos fazem uma petição ao governante.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-012/descript.source: The ruler sends the factors and their goods back in exchange for the captives.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-012/descript.pt: O governante envia os fatores e os seus bens de volta em troca dos cativos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-012/notes.source: Stanza 12; The factors and goods return and Gama releases some of the detainees.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-012/notes.pt: Estrofe 12; Os agentes e mercadorias regressam e Gama liberta alguns dos detidos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-013/descript.source: Gama leaves Calicut after the exchange without a secure trading treaty.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-013/descript.pt: Gama deixa Calecute após a troca sem um tratado comercial seguro.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-013/notes.source: Stanza 13; Gama leaves the coast without a settled peace or trading treaty.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-013/notes.pt: Estrofe 13; Gama deixa a costa sem uma paz estabelecida ou tratado comercial.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-014/descript.source: The fleet carries spices and Malabar people whom Gama takes by force.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-014/descript.pt: A frota transporta especiarias e gente Malabar que Gama leva à força.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-014/notes.source: Stanza 14; The ships take spices and Malabar people seized by force.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-014/notes.pt: Estrofe 14; Os navios levam especiarias e gente Malabar apreendida à força.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-015/descript.source: Monçaide joins the fleet carrying its cargo away from Calicut.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-015/descript.pt: Monçaide junta-se à frota que transporta a sua carga de Calecute.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-015/notes.source: Stanza 15; Monçaide joins the departing fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-015/notes.pt: Estrofe 15; Monçaide junta-se à frota que parte.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-016/descript.source: The ships turn from India toward Portugal.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-016/descript.pt: Os navios regressam da Índia a Portugal.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-016/notes.source: Stanza 16; The vessels turn toward Portugal with news of India.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-016/notes.pt: Estrofe 16; Os navios voltam-se para Portugal com notícias da Índia.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-018/descript.source: Venus reflects on how to grant the sailors rest after labor and danger.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-018/descript.pt: Vénus reflete sobre como conceder descanso aos marinheiros após o trabalho e o perigo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-018/notes.source: Stanza 18; Venus considers a reward for the exhausted sailors.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-018/notes.pt: Estrofe 18; Vénus considera uma recompensa para os marinheiros exaustos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-021/descript.source: Venus decides to prepare an island as a reward for the sailors.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-021/descript.pt: Vénus decide preparar uma ilha como recompensa para os marinheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-021/notes.source: Stanza 21; Venus chooses an island to prepare for the homeward company.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-021/notes.pt: Estrofe 21; Vénus escolhe uma ilha para se preparar para a companhia de regresso a casa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-023/descript.source: Venus decides that Cupid can help prepare the sailors’ reward.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-023/descript.pt: Vénus decide que Cupido pode ajudar a preparar a recompensa dos marinheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-023/notes.source: Stanza 23; Venus goes to ask her son for help.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-023/notes.pt: Estrofe 23; Vénus vai pedir ajuda ao filho.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-025/descript.source: Cupid readies an expedition while observing disordered loves in the world.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-025/descript.pt: Cupido prepara uma expedição enquanto observa amores desordenados no mundo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-025/notes.source: Stanza 25; Cupid prepares an undertaking before Venus arrives.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-025/notes.pt: Estrofe 25; Cupido prepara um empreendimento antes da chegada de Vénus.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-036/descript.source: Venus arrives and asks her son to support the plan.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-036/descript.pt: Vénus chega e pede ao filho que apoie o plano.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-036/notes.source: Stanza 36; Venus reaches Cupid and asks for his power.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-036/notes.pt: Estrofe 36; Vénus chega até Cupido e pede o seu poder.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-039/descript.source: Venus sets out how the nymphs will welcome the returning fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-039/descript.pt: Vénus explica como as ninfas darão as boas-vindas ao regresso da frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-039/notes.source: Stanza 39; Venus describes the intended welcome by the nymphs.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-039/notes.pt: Estrofe 39; Vénus descreve as boas-vindas pretendidas pelas ninfas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-043/descript.source: Cupid prepares the bow and arrows for the task Venus has given him.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-043/descript.pt: Cupido prepara o arco e as flechas para a tarefa que Vénus lhe deu.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-043/notes.source: Stanza 43; Cupid arms himself for the task his mother has set.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-043/notes.pt: Estrofe 43; Cupido arma-se para a tarefa que a mãe estabeleceu.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-044/descript.source: Cupid asks that Fame spread the sailors’ renown before he strikes.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-044/descript.pt: Cupido pede à Fama que espalhe a fama dos marinheiros antes de atacar.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-044/notes.source: Stanza 44; Cupid calls on Fame to spread the sailors’ renown.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-044/notes.pt: Estrofe 44; Cupido apela à Fama para espalhar a fama dos marinheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-047/descript.source: Cupid sends arrows into the sea to prepare the nymphs.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-047/descript.pt: Cupido envia flechas para o mar para preparar as ninfas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-047/notes.source: Stanza 47; Cupid sends arrows into the sea toward the nymphs.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-047/notes.pt: Estrofe 47; Cupido envia flechas para o mar em direção às ninfas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-048/descript.source: Cupid aims especially at Thetis among the nymphs.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-048/descript.pt: Cupido visa especialmente Tétis entre as ninfas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-048/notes.source: Stanza 48; Cupid aims especially at Thetis.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-049/descript.source: The sea and island are readied for the fleet and the nymphs take their places.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-049/descript.pt: O mar e a ilha estão preparados para a frota e as ninfas tomam os seus lugares.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-049/notes.source: Stanza 49; Venus directs the nymphs toward the approaching fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-049/notes.pt: Estrofe 49; Vénus encaminha as ninfas em direção à frota que se aproxima.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-050/descript.source: The sea nymphs follow Venus to the place prepared for the sailors.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-050/descript.pt: As ninfas do mar seguem Vénus até ao local preparado para os marinheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-050/notes.source: Stanza 50; Venus guides the sea nymphs to the prepared island.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-050/notes.pt: Estrofe 50; Vénus guia as ninfas do mar até à ilha preparada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-051/descript.source: The returning sailors see a green island in the sea and turn toward it for water.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-051/descript.pt: Os marinheiros que regressam vêem uma ilha verde no mar e voltam-se para ela em busca de água.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-051/notes.source: Stanza 51; The homeward fleet sights a green island while seeking water.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-051/notes.pt: Estrofe 51; A frota de regresso avista uma ilha verde enquanto procura água.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-052/descript.source: Venus brings the island into the fleet’s path; the crew sees its shore and vegetation.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-052/descript.pt: Vénus coloca a ilha no caminho da frota; a tripulação vê a sua costa e vegetação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-052/notes.source: Stanza 52; Venus moves the island toward the fleet.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-052/notes.pt: Estrofe 52; Vénus move a ilha em direção à frota.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-053/descript.source: Venus fixes the island after the voyagers sight it.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-053/descript.pt: Vénus repara a ilha depois de os viajantes a avistarem.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-053/notes.source: Stanza 53; Venus fixes the island after the ships notice it.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-053/notes.pt: Estrofe 53; Vénus repara a ilha depois que os navios percebem.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-054/descript.source: The poem surveys hills, springs, trees, and plants as the ships approach.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-054/descript.pt: O poema examina colinas, nascentes, árvores e plantas à medida que os navios se aproximam.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-054/notes.source: Stanza 54; The poem surveys the island’s hills, trees, springs, and animals.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-054/notes.pt: Estrofe 54; O poema examina as colinas, as árvores, as nascentes e os animais da ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-064/descript.source: The sailors disembark on the sheltered shore.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-064/descript.pt: Os marinheiros desembarcam na costa abrigada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-064/notes.source: Stanza 64; The sailors disembark on the sheltered island shore.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-064/notes.pt: Estrofe 64; Os marinheiros desembarcam na costa protegida da ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-065/descript.source: The nymphs spread through the island as the men come ashore.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-065/descript.pt: As ninfas espalharam-se pela ilha enquanto os homens desembarcavam.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-065/notes.source: Stanza 65; Nymphs spread among the trees under Venus’s earlier direction.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-065/notes.pt: Estrofe 65; As ninfas espalharam-se entre as árvores sob a direção anterior de Vénus.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-066/descript.source: The sailors set off from the beach into the wooded island.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-066/descript.pt: Os marinheiros partiram da praia para a ilha arborizada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-066/notes.source: Stanza 66; Sailors go inland seeking game without yet recognizing the nymphs.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-066/notes.pt: Estrofe 66; Os marinheiros vão para o interior em busca de caça, sem ainda reconhecerem as ninfas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-068/descript.source: The men catch their first glimpses of figures among the trees.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-068/descript.pt: Os homens avistam pela primeira vez figuras entre as árvores.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-068/notes.source: Stanza 68; The first colors of the hidden figures appear among branches.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-068/notes.pt: Estrofe 68; As primeiras cores das figuras escondidas aparecem entre os ramos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-069/descript.source: Veloso sees the women and calls the others toward them.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-069/descript.pt: Veloso vê as mulheres e chama os outros até elas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-069/notes.source: Stanza 69; Veloso calls attention to the figures among the trees.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-069/notes.pt: Estrofe 69; Veloso chama a atenção para as figuras entre as árvores.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-070/descript.source: The men follow the figures along the island paths.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-070/descript.pt: Os homens seguem as figuras pelos caminhos da ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-070/notes.source: Stanza 70; Veloso and other sailors follow the nymphs through the grove.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-070/notes.pt: Estrofe 70; Veloso e outros marinheiros seguem as ninfas pelo bosque.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-075/descript.source: Leonardo follows one nymph and speaks of his past disappointments in love.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-075/descript.pt: Leonardo segue uma ninfa e fala das suas desilusões amorosas passadas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-075/notes.source: Stanza 75; Leonardo pursues a nymph whose name has not yet been given.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-075/notes.pt: Estrofe 75; Leonardo persegue uma ninfa cujo nome ainda não foi divulgado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-076/descript.source: The nymph pursued by Leonardo is named Efire.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-076/descript.pt: A ninfa perseguida por Leonardo chama-se Efire.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-076/notes.source: Stanza 76; The poem names Efire as the nymph Leonardo follows.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-076/notes.pt: Estrofe 76; O poema nomeia Efire como a ninfa que Leonardo segue.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-082/descript.source: Efire stops fleeing and answers Leonardo’s pursuit.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-082/descript.pt: Efire deixa de fugir e responde à perseguição de Leonardo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-082/notes.source: Stanza 82; Efire stops and the pursuit becomes a direct encounter.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-082/notes.pt: Estrofe 82; Efire pára e a perseguição torna-se um encontro direto.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-084/descript.source: The nymphs and voyagers promise one another lasting honor and companionship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-084/descript.pt: As ninfas e os viajantes prometem uns aos outros honra e companhia duradouras.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-084/notes.source: Stanza 84; The pair joins a wider exchange of pledges on the island.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-084/notes.pt: Estrofe 84; A dupla junta-se a uma troca mais ampla de promessas na ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-085/descript.source: A leading nymph receives Gama apart from the other sailors.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-085/descript.pt: Uma ninfa líder recebe Gama à parte dos restantes marinheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-085/notes.source: Stanza 85; An unnamed leading nymph receives Gama apart from the sailors.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-085/notes.pt: Estrofe 85; Uma ninfa líder sem nome recebe Gama longe dos marinheiros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-085/title.pt: Gama conhece a rainha da ilha

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-087/descript.source: The queen leads Gama up to a high place and a rich hall.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-087/descript.pt: A rainha conduz Gama até um lugar alto e um rico salão.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-087/notes.source: Stanza 87; The island queen leads Gama up toward a crystal hall.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-087/notes.pt: Estrofe 87; A rainha da ilha conduz Gama em direção a um salão de cristal.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-087/title.pt: Em direção à altura da ilha

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-088/descript.source: The poet interprets the island’s pleasures as a figure for honor earned through action.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-088/descript.pt: O poeta interpreta os prazeres da ilha como uma figura de honra conquistada através da ação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-088/notes.source: Stanza 88; The poet begins to interpret the island’s pleasures as honor.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-088/notes.pt: Estrofe 88; O poeta passa a interpretar os prazeres da ilha como honra.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-089/descript.source: The poet names Thetis in explaining the island’s meaning.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-089/descript.pt: O poeta nomeia Tétis ao explicar o significado da ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-089/notes.source: Stanza 89; The poet names Thetis while interpreting the island image.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-089/notes.pt: Estrofe 89; O poeta nomeia Tétis ao interpretar a imagem da ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-092/descript.source: The poet asks what work and choices deserve a lasting name.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-092/descript.pt: O poeta pergunta que obras e escolhas merecem um nome duradouro.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-092/notes.source: Stanza 92; The poet calls for conduct worthy of lasting fame.
events/os-lusiadas-event-09-092/notes.pt: Estrofe 92; O poeta clama por uma conduta digna de fama duradoura.

events/os-lusiadas-event-09-092/title.pt: O caminho para a fama duradoura

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-001/descript.source: The day cools over the island before the company gathers.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-001/descript.pt: O dia arrefece na ilha antes de a companhia se reunir.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-001/notes.source: Stanza 1; The evening atmosphere changes before the feast begins.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-001/notes.pt: Estrofe 1; A atmosfera noturna muda antes do início da festa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-002/descript.source: The nymphs host the sailors at a feast prepared for them on the island.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-002/descript.pt: As ninfas recebem os marinheiros num banquete que lhes é preparado na ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-002/notes.source: Stanza 2; The nymphs and sailors gather at the queen’s prepared tables.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-002/notes.pt: Estrofe 2; As ninfas e os marinheiros reúnem-se nas mesas preparadas pela rainha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-006/descript.source: A nymph begins singing while the instruments answer her voice.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-006/descript.pt: Uma ninfa começa a cantar enquanto os instrumentos respondem à sua voz.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-006/notes.source: Stanza 6; A nymph starts to sing and the feast falls quiet around her.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-006/notes.pt: Estrofe 6; Uma ninfa começa a cantar e a festa cai em silêncio à sua volta.
