events/os-lusiadas-event-10-007/descript.source: The song’s account is traced to Proteus’s vision and the nymph’s memory.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-007/descript.pt: O relato da canção remonta à visão de Proteu e à memória da ninfa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-007/notes.source: Stanza 7; The source of the singer’s foreknowledge is explained.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-007/notes.pt: Estrofe 7; A fonte da presciência do cantor é explicada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-008/descript.source: The poet pauses to ask for strength to continue a subject he fears he cannot adequately sing.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-008/descript.pt: O poeta faz uma pausa para pedir forças para continuar um tema que teme não conseguir cantar adequadamente.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-008/notes.source: Stanza 8; The poet pauses over the challenge of singing future deeds.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-008/notes.pt: Estrofe 8; O poeta faz uma pausa no desafio de cantar os feitos futuros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-010/descript.source: A nymph begins a prophetic song of voyages and struggles still to come.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-010/descript.pt: Uma ninfa inicia um canto profético de viagens e lutas que ainda estão por vir.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-010/notes.source: Stanza 10; The singer begins the long prophecy before the island company.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-010/notes.pt: Estrofe 10; A cantora inicia a longa profecia perante a companhia da ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-022/descript.source: The singer lowers her voice to recount great service left unrewarded.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-022/descript.pt: A cantora baixa a voz para contar um grande serviço que não foi recompensado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-022/notes.source: Stanza 22; The singer lowers her voice as praise becomes reproach.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-022/notes.pt: Estrofe 22; A cantora baixa a voz enquanto o elogio se transforma em reprovação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-024/descript.source: The song measures the work of Duarte Pacheco against the favor kings grant their servants.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-024/descript.pt: A canção mede a obra de Duarte Pacheco face aos favores que os reis concedem aos seus servos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-024/notes.source: Stanza 24; The singer judges rulers who neglect those who served them.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-024/notes.pt: Estrofe 24; A cantora julga os governantes que negligenciam aqueles que os serviram.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-026/descript.source: The singer foretells the careers and losses of Francisco and Lourenço de Almeida.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-026/descript.pt: A cantora prenuncia as carreiras e as perdas de Francisco e Lourenço de Almeida.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-026/notes.source: Stanza 26; The prophecy turns to the Almeida family.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-026/notes.pt: Estrofe 26; A profecia volta-se para a família Almeida.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-033/descript.source: The prophecy turns to Francisco de Almeida’s grief and response to his son’s loss.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-033/descript.pt: A profecia volta-se para o luto de Francisco de Almeida e para a resposta à perda do filho.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-033/notes.source: Stanza 33; The song turns to a father’s grief and retaliation.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-033/notes.pt: Estrofe 33; A canção trata da dor e da retaliação de um pai.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-039/descript.source: The prophecy turns to Tristão da Cunha and other commanders in the eastern seas.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-039/descript.pt: A profecia dirige-se a Tristão da Cunha e a outros comandantes nos mares orientais.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-039/notes.source: Stanza 39; The singer raises her voice over new campaigns.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-039/notes.pt: Estrofe 39; A cantora levanta a voz em novas campanhas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-040/descript.source: Afonso de Albuquerque’s projected campaigns and rule occupy the singer’s next account.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-040/descript.pt: As campanhas e a regra projetadas por Afonso de Albuquerque ocupam a conta seguinte do cantor.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-040/notes.source: Stanza 40; The projected acts of Albuquerque become the song’s focus.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-040/notes.pt: Estrofe 40; Os atos projetados de Albuquerque passam a ser o foco da música.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-045/descript.source: The nymph pauses over cruelty toward his own men amid the commander’s fame.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-045/descript.pt: A ninfa faz uma pausa na crueldade contra os seus próprios homens no meio da fama do comandante.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-045/notes.source: Stanza 45; The singer criticizes harsh judgment of Albuquerque’s own people.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-045/notes.pt: Estrofe 45; A cantora critica o julgamento severo do próprio povo de Albuquerque.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-050/descript.source: The song follows later captains and governors through ports and conflicts around the Indian Ocean.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-050/descript.pt: A música segue capitães e governadores posteriores através de portos e conflitos em torno do Oceano Índico.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-050/notes.source: Stanza 50; The nymph resumes her longer sequence of future commanders.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-050/notes.pt: Estrofe 50; A ninfa retoma a sua longa sequência de futuros comandantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-063/descript.source: The projected campaigns continue through Martim Afonso de Sousa and others.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-063/descript.pt: As campanhas projectadas continuam através de Martim Afonso de Sousa e outros.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-063/notes.source: Stanza 63; The prophecy moves to another set of leaders and conflicts.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-063/notes.pt: Estrofe 63; A profecia passa para outro conjunto de líderes e conflitos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-073/descript.source: The nymph closes her forecast with an appeal to honor difficult achievements.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-073/descript.pt: A ninfa termina a sua previsão com um apelo para homenagear as conquistas difíceis.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-073/notes.source: Stanza 73; The singer closes by equating hard service with the island’s honor.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-073/notes.pt: Estrofe 73; A cantora termina equiparando o serviço árduo à honra da ilha.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-074/descript.source: The other nymphs answer the singer together and the feast celebrates the union.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-074/descript.pt: As restantes ninfas respondem em conjunto ao cantor e a festa celebra a união.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-074/notes.source: Stanza 74; The other nymphs answer the completed song with applause.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-074/notes.pt: Estrofe 74; As restantes ninfas respondem à música completa com aplausos.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-075/descript.source: Tethys invites Gama from the feast toward a further revelation.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-075/descript.pt: Tethys convida Gama da festa para uma nova revelação.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-075/notes.source: Stanza 75; Thetis addresses Gama by name after the feast.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-075/notes.pt: Estrofe 75; Tétis dirige-se a Gama pelo nome após a festa.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-076/descript.source: Tethys bids Gama follow through difficult growth toward the height.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-076/descript.pt: Tétis pede a Gama que siga através de um difícil crescimento em direção à altura.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-076/notes.source: Stanza 76; The pair climbs through difficult growth toward the height.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-076/notes.pt: Estrofe 76; O par sobe através de um crescimento difícil em direção à altura.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-077/descript.source: On a height, Tethys shows Gama a luminous globe displaying the world.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-077/descript.pt: Em cima, Tétis mostra a Gama um globo luminoso que mostra o mundo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-077/notes.source: Stanza 77; A luminous globe is visible to the pair at the summit.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-077/notes.pt: Estrofe 77; Um globo luminoso é visível para o par no cume.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-079/descript.source: Gama studies the suspended globe and Tethys tells him it offers a small image of the world.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-079/descript.pt: Gama estuda o globo suspenso e Tétis diz-lhe que oferece uma pequena imagem do mundo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-079/notes.source: Stanza 79; Gama examines the globe and Thetis explains its purpose.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-079/notes.pt: Estrofe 79; Gama examina o globo e Tétis explica o seu propósito.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-080/descript.source: Tethys explains the ordered spheres and their place in the poem’s account of creation.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-080/descript.pt: Tétis explica as esferas ordenadas e o seu lugar no relato da criação do poema.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-080/notes.source: Stanza 80; Thetis begins a cosmological explanation to Gama.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-080/notes.pt: Estrofe 80; Tétis inicia uma explicação cosmológica para Gama.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-091/descript.source: The explanation descends from the celestial circles to peoples, countries, and seas.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-091/descript.pt: A explicação desce dos círculos celestes até aos povos, países e mares.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-091/notes.source: Stanza 91; The globe’s account moves from celestial circles to inhabited earth.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-091/notes.pt: Estrofe 91; A conta do globo passa dos círculos celestes para a terra habitada.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-092/descript.source: The globe’s view turns to the Mediterranean, African coasts, and the route around the continent.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-092/descript.pt: A visão do globo volta-se para o Mediterrâneo, as costas africanas e a rota em torno do continente.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-092/notes.source: Stanza 92; Thetis traces Europe and Africa before the captain.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-092/notes.pt: Estrofe 92; Tétis traça a Europa e a África antes do capitão.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-098/descript.source: Tethys points out Suez, Sinai, Arabia, and the shores toward the Persian Gulf.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-098/descript.pt: Tétis aponta o Suez, o Sinai, a Arábia e as costas para o Golfo Pérsico.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-098/notes.source: Stanza 98; Thetis points across Suez, Arabia, and the Persian approaches.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-098/notes.pt: Estrofe 98; Tétis aponta para o Suez, a Arábia e as abordagens persas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-105/descript.source: Tethys traces the coasts and rivers of India, telling Gama of future contacts there.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-105/descript.pt: Tétis traça as costas e os rios da Índia, contando a Gama sobre futuros contactos ali.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-105/notes.source: Stanza 105; The geographic account reaches the Indian rivers and coasts.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-105/notes.pt: Estrofe 105; A conta geográfica atinge os rios e as costas indianas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-105/title.pt: A Índia e as suas costas

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-108/descript.source: The account turns from Indian regions to Thomas and the remembered site of his relics.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-108/descript.pt: O relato passa das regiões indianas para Thomas e o local recordado das suas relíquias.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-108/notes.source: Stanza 108; Thetis introduces Thomas’s remembered story amid the Indian survey.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-108/notes.pt: Estrofe 108; Tétis apresenta a história recordada de Thomas durante a pesquisa indiana.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-109/descript.source: Tethys recounts Thomas’s arrival and preaching at Meliapor.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-109/descript.pt: Tétis relata a chegada e a pregação de Tomé a Meliapor.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-109/notes.source: Stanza 109; Thetis recounts a past apostolic visit; Thomas is not enacted.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-109/notes.pt: Estrofe 109; Tétis relata uma visita apostólica passada; Thomas não foi promulgado.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-119/descript.source: The poet addresses religious workers of his own day before returning to the coast.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-119/descript.pt: O poeta dirige-se aos trabalhadores religiosos do seu tempo antes de regressar ao litoral.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-119/notes.source: Stanza 119; The poet directly rebukes workers of his own time.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-119/notes.pt: Estrofe 119; O poeta repreende diretamente os trabalhadores da sua época.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-120/descript.source: The globe’s geography and forecast continue from India toward farther eastern lands.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-120/descript.pt: A geografia e as previsões do globo continuam a partir da Índia em direção às terras mais orientais.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-120/notes.source: Stanza 120; Thetis resumes her account of the eastern coast.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-120/notes.pt: Estrofe 120; Tétis retoma o seu relato sobre a costa oriental.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-120/title.pt: Do outro lado da Baía de Bengala

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-125/descript.source: Tethys points through Southeast Asian waters and toward more distant islands.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-125/descript.pt: O Tétis aponta através das águas do Sudeste Asiático e em direção a ilhas mais distantes.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-125/notes.source: Stanza 125; The survey moves through the Southeast Asian straits.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-125/notes.pt: Estrofe 125; A pesquisa percorre o estreito do Sudeste Asiático.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-138/descript.source: The vision turns to the Atlantic and future crossings associated with the Americas.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-138/descript.pt: A visão volta-se para o Atlântico e para as futuras travessias associadas às Américas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-138/notes.source: Stanza 138; Thetis turns the globe’s forecast from east to west.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-138/notes.pt: Estrofe 138; Tétis muda a previsão do globo de leste para oeste.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-138/title.pt: Do outro lado do mar ocidental

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-142/descript.source: Tethys ends the forecast and sends the sailors back toward their homeland.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-142/descript.pt: Tétis termina a previsão e envia os marinheiros de volta para a sua terra natal.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-142/notes.source: Stanza 142; Thetis concludes the granted vision and bids the voyagers return.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-142/notes.pt: Estrofe 142; Tétis conclui a visão concedida e ordena aos viajantes que regressem.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-143/descript.source: The voyagers embark with provisions and the nymphs’ continuing companionship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-143/descript.pt: Os viajantes embarcam com provisões e a companhia contínua das ninfas.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-143/notes.source: Stanza 143; The island company embarks with provisions and a fair wind.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-143/notes.pt: Estrofe 143; A companhia insular embarca com provisões e vento favorável.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-144/descript.source: The fleet crosses a calm sea and returns to the mouth of the Tagus.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-144/descript.pt: A frota atravessa um mar calmo e regressa à foz do Tejo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-144/notes.source: Stanza 144; The homeward ships enter the Tagus after calm sailing.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-144/notes.pt: Estrofe 144; Os navios de regresso entram no Tejo depois de uma navegação tranquila.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-145/descript.source: The poet stops his account and speaks of his country’s failure to value its own art and service.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-145/descript.pt: O poeta interrompe o seu relato e fala do fracasso do seu país em valorizar a sua própria arte e serviço.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-145/notes.source: Stanza 145; The poet stops the voyage and addresses his own country.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-145/notes.pt: Estrofe 145; O poeta interrompe a viagem e dirige-se para o seu país.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-145/title.source: The poet lays down his song
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-145/title.pt: O poeta estabelece a sua canção

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-146/descript.source: The poet asks the king to look at those who have carried the state’s work through hardship.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-146/descript.pt: O poeta pede ao rei que olhe para aqueles que realizaram o trabalho do Estado no meio das dificuldades.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-146/notes.source: Stanza 146; The poet asks the king to value those who served him.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-146/notes.pt: Estrofe 146; O poeta pede ao rei que valorize aqueles que o serviram.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-150/descript.source: The poet urges D. Sebastião to judge and employ his people wisely.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-150/descript.pt: O poeta exorta D. Sebastião a julgar e a empregar sabiamente o seu povo.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-150/notes.source: Stanza 150; The poet gives counsel about how to employ the realm’s people.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-150/notes.pt: Estrofe 150; O poeta dá conselhos sobre como empregar o povo do reino.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-151/descript.source: The poet asks that hard won service be valued and points to the king’s future task.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-151/descript.pt: O poeta pede que o serviço arduamente conquistado seja valorizado e aponta para a tarefa futura do rei.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-151/notes.source: Stanza 151; The poet turns to service in arms and the king’s leadership.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-151/notes.pt: Estrofe 151; O poeta recorre ao serviço militar e à liderança do rei.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-154/descript.source: The poet closes by offering experience and song to the king, ending with the last verse of the poem.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-154/descript.pt: O poeta termina oferecendo experiência e canto ao rei, terminando com a última estrofe do poema.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-154/notes.source: Stanza 154; The poet offers his own experience and craft to the king.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-154/notes.pt: Estrofe 154; O poeta oferece ao rei a sua própria experiência e habilidade.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-154/title.pt: Uma oferta para cantar de novo

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-155/descript.source: The poet offers both military service and his art if the king will accept them.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-155/descript.pt: O poeta oferece tanto o serviço militar como a sua arte, se o rei os aceitar.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-155/notes.source: Stanza 155; The offer joins martial service to the making of song.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-155/notes.pt: Estrofe 155; A oferta une o serviço marcial à composição da música.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-156/descript.source: The poem ends by offering to sing the king’s future deeds.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-156/descript.pt: O poema termina oferecendo-se para cantar os feitos futuros do rei.

events/os-lusiadas-event-10-156/notes.source: Stanza 156; The poet closes with a promise to sing a worthy future deed.
events/os-lusiadas-event-10-156/notes.pt: Estrofe 156; O poeta termina com a promessa de cantar um feito futuro digno.

mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-ocean/descript.source: The Atlantic turn around Africa and the Indian Ocean crossing, set on a geographically scaled chart.
mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-ocean/descript.pt: O regresso do Atlântico em torno de África e a travessia do Oceano Índico, definido numa carta à escala geográfica.

mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-iberia/descrip.source: The departure coast and the places of the monarchy recalled in Gama’s account.
mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-iberia/descrip.pt: A costa de partida e os lugares da monarquia recordados no relato de Gama.

mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-east-africa/de.source: The ports and coastal approaches between Sofala and Melinde.
mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-east-africa/de.pt: Os portos e as aproximações costeiras entre Sofala e Melinde.

mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-malabar/descri.source: The coast reached by the fleet after its Indian Ocean crossing.
mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-malabar/descri.pt: A costa atingida pela frota após a travessia do Oceano Índico.

mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-calicut-city/d.source: A schematic plan of the landing, royal audience, and trading sites.
mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-calicut-city/d.pt: Um plano esquemático do desembarque, da audiência real e dos locais de comércio.

mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-england/descri.source: The English court and a continental stop in Veloso’s shipboard tale.
mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-england/descri.pt: A corte inglesa e uma paragem continental na história a bordo de Veloso.

mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-island/descrip.source: An allegorical island, drawn from the poem without earthly coordinates.
mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-island/descrip.pt: Uma ilha alegórica, extraída do poema sem coordenadas terrenas.

mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-divine/descrip.source: A conceptual chart of the poem’s divine councils, high air, and sea.
mapLayers/os-lusiadas-map-divine/descrip.pt: Um gráfico conceptual dos conselhos divinos, do alto ar e do mar do poema.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-lisbon-s.source: The Tagus mouth from which the fleet’s long sea road begins.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-lisbon-s.pt: A foz do Tejo onde começa o longo caminho marítimo da frota.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-east-afr.source: An island coast ahead of the fleet, before its name is learned.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-east-afr.pt: Uma costa insular à frente da frota, antes de se conhecer o seu nome.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-atlantic.source: The open-water turn west of Africa before the cape.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-atlantic.pt: A curva em mar aberto a oeste de África antes do cabo.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-ocean-cr.source: The long open-sea passage between East Africa and the coast of India.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-ocean-cr.pt: A longa passagem em mar aberto entre a África Oriental e a costa da Índia.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-cape-ver.source: The Atlantic islands west of Africa passed early in the outward voyage.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-cape-ver.pt: As ilhas atlânticas a oeste de África passaram no início da viagem de ida.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-st-helen.source: A sheltered bay on the west coast of southern Africa where the fleet pauses.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-st-helen.pt: Uma baía protegida na costa ocidental da África Austral onde a frota faz uma pausa.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-southern.source: A sheltered bay on the southern African coast where the crew lands and measures the sun.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-southern.pt: Uma baía abrigada na costa sul de África onde a tripulação aterra e mede o sol.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-cape/des.source: The headland at Africa’s southern turn, where Atlantic and Indian Ocean passage meet.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-cape/des.pt: O promontório na curva sul de África, onde se encontra a passagem do Oceano Atlântico e do Oceano Índico.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-southern.source: A dark southern headland approached by the fleet before the apparition explains its place.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-southern.pt: Um promontório escuro a sul abordado pela frota antes da aparição explica o seu lugar.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-southern.source: A shore beyond the cape where people greet the fleet with music and trade.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-southern.pt: Uma costa para lá do cabo onde as pessoas saúdam a frota com música e comércio.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-southern.source: The long coast north and east of the cape where currents slow the ships.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-southern.pt: A longa costa a norte e a leste do cabo, onde as correntes atrasam os navios.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-suez/des.source: The head of the Red Sea invoked when the poem explains the trading network opposing the fleet.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-suez/des.pt: A cabeça do Mar Vermelho invocada quando o poema explica a rede comercial que se opõe à frota.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-jeddah/d.source: The Red Sea port from which large trading ships sail to Malabar in the poem’s account.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-jeddah/d.pt: O porto do Mar Vermelho de onde os grandes navios mercantes navegam para o Malabar no relato do poema.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mozambiq.source: An island and channel on the East African coast where the fleet first makes sustained contact.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mozambiq.pt: Uma ilha e canal na costa da África Oriental onde a frota faz o primeiro contacto sustentado.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mombasa-.source: A Swahili coast city reached after the Mozambique passage.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mombasa-.pt: Uma cidade costeira suaíli alcançada após a passagem de Moçambique.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-melinde-.source: A northern East African port and roadstead.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-melinde-.pt: Um porto e enseada no norte da África Oriental.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-calicut-.source: The Malabar landfall toward which the fleet has crossed the Indian Ocean.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-calicut-.pt: O desembarque do Malabar em direção ao qual a frota atravessou o Oceano Índico.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-lisbon/d.source: The Tagus shore where the ships are prepared and families gather for the departure.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-lisbon/d.pt: A costa do Tejo onde os navios são preparados e as famílias se reúnem para a partida.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-coimbra/.source: The Mondego city associated with the remembered court and Inês’s story.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-coimbra/.pt: A cidade do Mondego associada à corte recordada e à história de Inês.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-ourique/.source: Southern Portuguese ground associated in the poem with Afonso Henriques’s battle.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-ourique/.pt: Terra do sul de Portugal associada no poema à batalha de Afonso Henriques.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-aljubarr.source: The field near Batalha where John’s forces meet the Castilian army.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-aljubarr.pt: O campo perto da Batalha onde as forças de João enfrentam o exército castelhano.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-badajoz/.source: A fortified border city in the account of the first king’s campaigns.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-badajoz/.pt: Cidade fronteiriça fortificada no relato das campanhas do primeiro rei.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-ceuta/de.source: The North African city reached by Portuguese ships during John I’s reign.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-ceuta/de.pt: A cidade do Norte de África alcançada pelos navios portugueses durante o reinado de D. João I.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-porto/de.source: The northern Portuguese city on the Douro in the poem’s homeland survey.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-porto/de.pt: A cidade do norte de Portugal no Douro no levantamento da pátria do poema.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-guimarae.source: The northern stronghold where Afonso is besieged in Gama’s account.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-guimarae.pt: O reduto nortenho onde Afonso está cercado na conta do Gama.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-salado/d.source: The southern battle ground where Portuguese and Castilian forces meet.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-salado/d.pt: O campo de batalha do sul onde se encontram as forças portuguesas e castelhanas.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-portugal.source: The central region standing for broad kingdom-wide passages without a single named site.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-portugal.pt: A região central representa amplas passagens por todo o reino sem um único local nomeado.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-evora/de.source: The inland city taken through Giraldo’s daring in the poem’s historical account.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-evora/de.pt: A cidade do interior tomada pela ousadia de Giraldo no relato histórico do poema.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-beja/des.source: The southern city where the poem describes violence after Afonso’s victory.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-beja/des.pt: A cidade do sul onde o poema descreve a violência após a vitória de Afonso.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-santarem.source: The Tagus-side town where Sancho is besieged before his father comes to help.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-santarem.pt: A cidade à beira do Tejo onde Sancho é cercado antes de o pai vir ajudar.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-silves/d.source: The Algarve stronghold besieged by Sancho with aid from a passing fleet.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-silves/d.pt: O reduto algarvio cercado por Sancho com a ajuda de uma frota de passagem.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-sofala/d.source: A southern East African port named among the coast’s trading settlements.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-sofala/d.pt: Um porto do sul da África Oriental considerado um dos povoados comerciais da costa.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mozambiq.source: The island harbor where the Portuguese question visitors and seek a pilot.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mozambiq.pt: O porto insular onde os portugueses questionam os visitantes e procuram um piloto.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mozambiq.source: The landing and watering shore beside the island anchorage.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mozambiq.pt: A costa de desembarque e rega junto ao ancoradouro da ilha.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-kilwa/de.source: An island city farther north on the East African passage.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-kilwa/de.pt: Uma cidade-ilha mais a norte, na passagem da África Oriental.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mombasa/.source: The harbor mouth and city approached after Mozambique.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mombasa/.pt: A foz do porto e a cidade aproximavam-se depois de Moçambique.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mombasa-.source: The city shore facing the fleet’s anchorage.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-mombasa-.pt: A orla da cidade virada para o ancoradouro da frota.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-melinde/.source: The anchorage where the local ruler welcomes the fleet and asks for its story.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-melinde/.pt: O ancoradouro onde o governante local acolhe a frota e pergunta a sua história.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-melinde-.source: The landing and royal gathering place beside the roadstead.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-melinde-.pt: O local de desembarque e de encontro real junto ao ancoradouro.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-good-sig.source: The East African river where the fleet finds speakers of Arabic and raises a stone marker; its precise identification is editorial.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-good-sig.pt: O rio da África Oriental onde a frota se encontra com falantes de árabe e ergue uma lápide de pedra; a sua identificação precisa é editorial.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-calicut/.source: The trading city named by fishermen as the Portuguese fleet draws near.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-calicut/.pt: A cidade comercial nomeada pelos pescadores à medida que a frota portuguesa se aproxima.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-cannanor.source: A port north of Calicut named in the Indian coastal setting.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-cannanor.pt: Um porto a norte de Calecute nomeado no cenário costeiro indiano.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-cochin/d.source: A trading port farther south on the Malabar coast.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-cochin/d.pt: Um porto comercial mais a sul, na costa do Malabar.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-roadstea.source: Open water off the city where the Portuguese ships lie at anchor.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-roadstea.pt: Águas abertas ao largo da cidade onde estão fundeados os navios portugueses.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-landing/.source: A shore landing from which Gama enters the city.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-landing/.pt: Um desembarque em terra por onde Gama entra na cidade.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-fishing-.source: The working waterfront used by local fishing boats.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-fishing-.pt: A orla em funcionamento utilizada pelos barcos de pesca locais.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-shrine/d.source: A place of local worship encountered on the way inland.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-shrine/d.pt: Um local de culto local encontrado no caminho para o interior.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-official.source: A residence used by a court official during the Portuguese visit.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-official.pt: Residência utilizada por um funcionário judicial durante a visita portuguesa.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-royal-co.source: The ruler’s audience place within Calicut.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-royal-co.pt: O público do governante fica em Calecute.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-merchant.source: A district of traders whose goods and counsel shape the port’s business.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-merchant.pt: Um distrito de comerciantes cujos produtos e conselhos moldam os negócios do porto.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-warehous.source: A place for cargo and merchants near the city’s trade routes.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-warehous.pt: Um local para cargas e comerciantes junto às rotas comerciais da cidade.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-moncaide.source: The resident’s home where he offers the Portuguese messenger rest and a meal.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-moncaide.pt: Casa do morador onde oferece descanso e refeição ao mensageiro português.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-city-rou.source: The streets and gardens crossed between the landing and royal audience.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-city-rou.pt: As ruas e os jardins cruzavam-se entre o desembarque e a audiência real.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-england-.source: A courtly setting for the challenge described in Veloso’s tale.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-england-.pt: Um cenário cortês para o desafio descrito no conto de Veloso.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-channel/.source: The sea passage between continental Europe and England in the tale.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-channel/.pt: A passagem marítima entre a Europa continental e a Inglaterra no conto.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-flanders.source: The Low Countries region where Magriço pauses on his overland way and later remains.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-flanders.pt: A região dos Países Baixos onde Magriço faz uma pausa no seu caminho terrestre e depois permanece.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-olympus/.source: The luminous height where the gods assemble to debate human voyages.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-olympus/.pt: A altura luminosa onde os deuses se reúnem para debater as viagens humanas.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-divine-c.source: The divine gathering place presided over by Jupiter.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-divine-c.pt: O local de encontro divino presidido por Júpiter.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-high-air.source: The mythic sky through which gods carry messages and warnings.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-high-air.pt: O céu mítico através do qual os deuses transmitem mensagens e avisos.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-night-sk.source: The darkened air above a sleeping captain and his fleet.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-night-sk.pt: O ar escuro por cima de um capitão adormecido e da sua frota.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-wind-qua.source: The allegorical quarter from which Aeolus releases opposing winds.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-wind-qua.pt: O bairro alegórico de onde Éolo liberta ventos opostos.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-sea-surf.source: The sea surface where nymphs and ships meet in the poem’s divine action.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-sea-surf.pt: A superfície do mar onde ninfas e navios se encontram na ação divina do poema.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-undersea.source: A hall beneath the sea where the sea gods are called to counsel.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-undersea.pt: Um salão no fundo do mar onde os deuses do mar são chamados a aconselhar.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-b.source: A sheltered landing at the wooded island.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-b.pt: Um pouso protegido na ilha arborizada.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-g.source: Trees and paths inland from the landing beach.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-g.pt: Árvores e caminhos para o interior a partir da praia de desembarque.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-p.source: A winding path through the island’s low ground.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-p.pt: Um caminho sinuoso pelo terreno baixo da ilha.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-t.source: An open height large enough for the company to gather.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-t.pt: Uma altura aberta suficientemente grande para a empresa se reunir.

locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-h.source: High ground overlooking the sea and the island below.
locationMarkers/os-lusiadas-loc-island-h.pt: Terreno elevado com vista para o mar e para a ilha em baixo.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-g/descriptio.source: The Portuguese captain who leads the fleet across the seas toward India.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-g/descriptio.pt: O capitão português que lidera a frota através dos mares em direção à Índia.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-j/descriptio.source: The Olympian presiding over a council about the voyagers.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-j/descriptio.pt: O atleta olímpico a presidir a um conselho sobre os viajantes.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-b/descriptio.source: A god who fears the sailors will eclipse his fame in the East.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-b/descriptio.pt: Um deus que teme os marinheiros eclipsará a sua fama no Oriente.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-v/descriptio.source: A goddess who favors the Portuguese fleet in the poem’s divine action.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-v/descriptio.pt: Uma deusa que favorece a frota portuguesa na ação divina do poema.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-m/descriptio.source: The god of war who speaks for the voyage at the Olympian council.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-m/descriptio.pt: O deus da guerra que fala pela viagem no conselho olímpico.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-q/descriptio.source: The island ruler who receives the fleet off the East African coast.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-q/descriptio.pt: O governante da ilha que recebe a frota na costa da África Oriental.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-p/descriptio.source: A pilot offered to the fleet after its first African landfall.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-p/descriptio.pt: Um piloto oferecido à frota após a sua primeira chegada a África.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-t/descriptio.source: A sea messenger who bears Venus toward the Portuguese vessels.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-t/descriptio.pt: Mensageiro marítimo que leva Vénus até às embarcações portuguesas.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-e/descriptio.source: A divine messenger sent from Olympus to prepare the sailors’ welcome.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-e/descriptio.pt: Um mensageiro divino enviado do Olimpo para preparar as boas-vindas aos marinheiros.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-k/descriptio.source: The coastal ruler who welcomes the sailors at Melinde.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-k/descriptio.pt: O governante costeiro que dá as boas-vindas aos marinheiros em Melinde.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-le/descripti.source: The Leonese ruler whose campaigns enter Gama’s account of Iberia.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-le/descripti.pt: O governante leonês cujas campanhas entram no relato de Gama sobre a Península Ibérica.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-he/descripti.source: A count whose marriage and territorial grant begin the Portuguese dynastic account.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-he/descripti.pt: Um conde cujo casamento e concessão territorial iniciam a conta dinástica portuguesa.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-te/descripti.source: The daughter given in marriage to Count Henrique in that account.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-te/descripti.pt: A filha dada em casamento ao conde Henrique nesta conta.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ah/descripti.source: The first Portuguese king as remembered in Gama’s account.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ah/descripti.pt: O primeiro rei português recordado no relato de Gama.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-eg/descripti.source: A loyal household servant drawn into the disputed allegiance of the early kingdom.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-eg/descripti.pt: Um leal criado doméstico atraído pela disputada lealdade do reino primitivo.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ew/descripti.source: The wife who accompanies Egas Moniz and their children before the Castilian court.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ew/descripti.pt: A esposa que acompanha Egas Moniz e os filhos perante a corte castelhana.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ck/descripti.source: A Castilian ruler who hears Egas Moniz’s fulfillment of a difficult pledge.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ck/descripti.pt: Um governante castelhano que ouve o cumprimento de uma promessa difícil por parte de Egas Moniz.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ck/name.pt: Governante castelhano no relato de Egas

characters/os-lusiadas-char-is/descripti.source: A commander among the opposing kings at Ourique in Gama’s historical account.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-is/descripti.pt: Comandante entre os reis adversários em Ourique no relato histórico do Gama.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ch/descripti.source: The crucified figure appearing in Afonso’s vision before battle.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ch/descripti.pt: A figura crucificada que surge na visão de Afonso antes da batalha.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-gi/descripti.source: A daring Portuguese fighter associated with the taking of Évora.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-gi/descripti.pt: Um ousado lutador português associado à tomada de Évora.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-br/descripti.source: The ruler resisting Afonso’s advance at fortified Badajoz.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-br/descripti.pt: O governante resiste ao avanço de Afonso na fortificada Badajoz.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-sa/descripti.source: Afonso’s son, shown leading armed men before inheriting the crown.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-sa/descripti.pt: Filho de Afonso, mostrado a liderar homens armados antes de herdar a coroa.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-a2/descripti.source: A Portuguese king recalled for a southern campaign after Sancho.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-a2/descripti.pt: Um rei português foi chamado de volta para uma campanha no sul depois de Sancho.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-s2/descripti.source: A successor whose reliance on courtiers becomes part of Gama’s account.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-s2/descripti.pt: Um sucessor cuja confiança nos cortesãos passa a fazer parte da conta de Gama.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-a3/descripti.source: Sancho’s brother, drawn into a dispute over rule before taking the crown.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-a3/descripti.pt: Irmão de Sancho, envolvido numa disputa pelo governo antes de assumir a coroa.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-di/descripti.source: A king remembered for law, peace, and the advancement of learning.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-di/descripti.pt: Um rei recordado pela lei, pela paz e pelo avanço da aprendizagem.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-a4/descripti.source: Dinis’s successor, whose relations with Castile enter the historical account.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-a4/descripti.pt: Sucessor de Dinis, cujas relações com Castela entram no relato histórico.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ma/descripti.source: A Portuguese princess who asks her father to aid the Castilian kingdom.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ma/descripti.pt: Uma princesa portuguesa que pede ao pai que ajude o reino castelhano.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-cl/descripti.source: The Castilian king fighting beside Afonso on the field at Salado.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-cl/descripti.pt: O rei castelhano a combater ao lado de Afonso no campo do Salado.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-in/descripti.source: A woman at the Portuguese court whose fate enters Gama’s history.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-in/descripti.pt: Uma mulher da corte portuguesa cujo destino entra na história da Gama.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-pe/descripti.source: The heir whose connection to Inês enters the royal history.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-pe/descripti.pt: O herdeiro cuja ligação a Inês entra na história real.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-fe/descripti.source: Pedro’s successor, whose reign brings an invasion and succession dispute.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-fe/descripti.pt: Sucessor de Pedro, cujo reinado traz uma disputa de invasão e sucessão.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ji/descripti.source: The king at the center of the succession struggle described in the poem.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ji/descripti.pt: O rei no centro da luta pela sucessão descrita no poema.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-nu/descripti.source: The Portuguese commander who counsels and leads in the succession war.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-nu/descripti.pt: O comandante português que aconselha e lidera na guerra de sucessão.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-du/descripti.source: The heir whose reign follows John’s in Gama’s account.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-du/descripti.pt: O herdeiro cujo reinado se segue ao de João no relato de Gama.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-fp/descripti.source: A Portuguese prince held after a failed North African undertaking.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-fp/descripti.pt: Um príncipe português detido após um empreendimento falhado no Norte de África.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-av/descripti.source: A king whose campaigns extend the dynastic account across North Africa.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-av/descripti.pt: Um rei cujas campanhas estendem a conta dinástica a todo o Norte de África.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-fa/descripti.source: The Aragonese ruler who opposes Afonso’s Castilian intervention.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-fa/descripti.pt: O governante aragonês que se opõe à intervenção castelhana de Afonso.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-j2/descripti.source: A young royal heir taking part in his father’s Castilian campaign.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-j2/descripti.pt: Um jovem herdeiro real a participar na campanha castelhana do seu pai.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-mn/descripti.source: The king who commands the search for a sea route to India.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-mn/descripti.pt: O rei que comanda a procura de uma rota marítima para a Índia.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-rf/descripti.source: An elder figure rising from the river in a vision of the kingdom.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-rf/descripti.pt: Uma figura idosa a subir do rio numa visão do reino.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-rs/descripti.source: A second elder who appears with the first in the river vision.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-rs/descripti.pt: Um segundo ancião que aparece com o primeiro na visão do rio.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-pg/descripti.source: Gama’s brother and a captain aboard the fleet.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-pg/descripti.pt: Irmão de Gama e capitão a bordo da frota.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-nc/descripti.source: A Portuguese captain whose ship accompanies Gama.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-nc/descripti.pt: Capitão português cujo navio acompanha Gama.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-om/descripti.source: An elder on the departure shore who addresses the sailors from the crowd.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-om/descripti.pt: Um ancião na margem de partida que se dirige aos marinheiros no meio da multidão.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ve/descripti.source: A sailor whose report and shipboard tale interrupt the passage.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ve/descripti.pt: Um marinheiro cujo relato e história a bordo interrompem a passagem.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ad/descripti.source: A vast figure who appears at the southern headland.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ad/descripti.pt: Uma figura vasta que aparece no promontório sul.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-do/descripti.source: A sea nymph who carries an answer to the giant at the headland.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-do/descripti.pt: Uma ninfa do mar que leva uma resposta ao gigante no promontório.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-th/descripti.source: A sea goddess who enters the remembered story at the southern headland.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-th/descripti.pt: Uma deusa do mar que entra na história recordada no promontório sul.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-fm/descripti.source: A sailor able to understand the Arabic speech encountered on the coast.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-fm/descripti.pt: Um marinheiro capaz de compreender a língua árabe que se encontra na costa.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-np/descripti.source: The sea god who gathers an undersea council.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-np/descripti.pt: O deus do mar que reúne um conselho submarino.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-pro/descript.source: A sea god whose foreknowledge is sought by the divine company.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-pro/descript.pt: Um deus do mar cuja presciência é procurada pela companhia divina.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-amp/descript.source: The figure beside Neptune at the undersea council, first seen without a name.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-amp/descript.pt: A figura ao lado de Neptuno no conselho submarino, vista pela primeira vez sem nome.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-aeo/descript.source: The keeper of the winds called into the conflict over the fleet.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-aeo/descript.pt: O guardião dos ventos convocou o conflito pela frota.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-li/descripti.source: A sailor who speaks to his companions during the crossing.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-li/descripti.pt: Um marinheiro que conversa com os seus companheiros durante a travessia.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-dl/descripti.source: An English nobleman appealed to by women in Veloso’s shipboard tale.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-dl/descripti.pt: Um nobre inglês apelado pelas mulheres na história a bordo de Veloso.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-mg/descripti.source: A Portuguese champion who chooses a separate road to England.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-mg/descripti.pt: Um campeão português que escolhe um caminho separado para Inglaterra.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ml/descripti.source: The woman awaiting her assigned champion at the English court.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ml/descripti.pt: A mulher aguardando o seu campeão designado na corte inglesa.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ek/descripti.source: The ruler before whom the challenge of Veloso’s tale is fought.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ek/descripti.pt: O governante perante o qual se trava o desafio do conto de Veloso.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ek/name.pt: Rei inglês no conto de Veloso

characters/os-lusiadas-char-sm/descripti.source: The ship’s master who directs the crew as the sea rises.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-sm/descripti.pt: O comandante do navio que dirige a tripulação à medida que o mar sobe.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-bo/descripti.source: A violent wind personified in the storm facing the fleet.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-bo/descripti.pt: Um vento violento personificado na tempestade que enfrenta a frota.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-or/descripti.source: The figure who addresses Boreas and asks him to relent.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-or/descripti.pt: A figura que se dirige a Bóreas e lhe pede que ceda.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-no/descripti.source: Another personified wind driven toward the Portuguese ships.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-no/descripti.pt: Outro vento personificado impulsionado em direção aos navios portugueses.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ga/descripti.source: A sea figure who appeals to Notus during the storm.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ga/descripti.pt: Uma figura do mar que apela a Notus durante a tempestade.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-mp/descripti.source: A pilot taken aboard for the crossing from East Africa to India.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-mp/descripti.pt: Um piloto levado a bordo para a travessia da África Oriental para a Índia.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-pm/descripti.source: The first envoy sent from the ships to announce their arrival at Calicut.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-pm/descripti.pt: O primeiro enviado enviado dos navios para anunciar a sua chegada a Calecute.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-mo/descripti.source: A resident of Calicut from Berberia who speaks with the Portuguese visitors.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-mo/descripti.pt: Morador em Calecute, da Berbéria, que fala com os visitantes portugueses.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-cat/descript.source: An officer of the Calicut court assigned to the foreign visitors.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-cat/descript.pt: Um oficial da corte de Calecute destacado para atender os visitantes estrangeiros.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-sam/descript.source: The ruler who receives the Portuguese embassy in Calicut.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-sam/descript.pt: O governante que recebe a embaixada portuguesa em Calecute.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-div/descript.source: A court diviner asked to examine signs about the arriving strangers.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-div/descript.pt: Um adivinho da corte pediu para examinar sinais sobre a chegada de estranhos.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-cler/descrip.source: A religious figure in Calicut who dreams of a warning about the visitors.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-cler/descrip.pt: Uma figura religiosa de Calecute que sonha com um aviso sobre os visitantes.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-al/descripti.source: One of two Portuguese factors left ashore with the fleet’s goods.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-al/descripti.pt: Um dos dois factores portugueses que desembarcaram com as mercadorias da frota.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-dg/descripti.source: The second factor responsible for Portuguese goods at Calicut.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-dg/descripti.pt: O segundo factor responsável pelos produtos portugueses em Calecute.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-cu/descripti.source: Venus’s son, first shown preparing his arrows on Ida.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-cu/descripti.pt: Filho de Vénus, mostrado pela primeira vez a preparar as suas flechas em Ida.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-fame/descrip.source: An allegorical figure summoned to carry the sailors’ renown.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-fame/descrip.pt: Figura alegórica convocada para carregar a fama dos marinheiros.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-ep/descripti.source: A nymph who joins the island encounter with a sailor.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-ep/descripti.pt: Uma ninfa que chega à ilha encontra um marinheiro.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-iq/descripti.source: A leading nymph who receives the Portuguese captain apart from the company.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-iq/descripti.pt: Uma ninfa líder que recebe o capitão português à parte da companhia.

characters/os-lusiadas-char-sn/descripti.source: The nymph whose song at the island feast tells of future deeds.
characters/os-lusiadas-char-sn/descripti.pt: A ninfa cuja canção na festa da ilha fala de feitos futuros.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Leads the fleet across open water off East Africa before the first local contact.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Lidera a frota em águas abertas ao largo da África Oriental antes do primeiro contacto local.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Opens the divine council and frames the question of the sailors’ passage.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Abre o conselho divino e enquadra a questão da passagem dos marinheiros.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Hears the opposition and defense that follow his first pronouncement.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ouve a oposição e a defesa que se seguem ao seu primeiro pronunciamento.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Objects that Portuguese success in the East will eclipse his own fame.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Objectiva que o sucesso português no Oriente eclipsará a sua própria fama.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Argues for the sailors in the face of Bacchus’s objection.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Argumenta pelos marinheiros perante a objeção de Baco.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives Mars’s demand to uphold the course he has set.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe a exigência de Marte para manter o rumo que estabeleceu.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Faces an additional argument against his attempt to stop the voyage.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Enfrenta um argumento adicional contra a sua tentativa de interromper a viagem.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Hears Mars reinforce her defense of the fleet.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ouve Marte reforçar a sua defesa da frota.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Urges Jupiter to keep his decision and give the voyagers a safe harbor.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Exorta Júpiter a manter a sua decisão e a dar aos viajantes um porto seguro.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Keeps the ships moving past the islands off East Africa.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Mantém os navios a passar pelas ilhas da África Oriental.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives unfamiliar visitors in boats and questions what they know of the coast.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe visitantes desconhecidos em barcos e questiona o que sabem da costa.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Learns the name Mozambique and hears visitors list other coastal ports.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Aprende o nome Moçambique e ouve os visitantes enumerarem outros portos costeiros.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Hosts the island ruler aboard and answers questions about his fleet and destination.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe o governante da ilha a bordo e responde a perguntas sobre a sua frota e destino.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Boards the Portuguese ship and studies the visitors while questioning their purpose.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Embarca no navio português e estuda os visitantes questionando o seu propósito.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Asks the ruler to supply a pilot for the route toward India.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Pede ao governante que forneça um piloto para a rota em direção à Índia.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Offers navigational help while concealing his hostility to the ships.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Oferece ajuda à navegação enquanto esconde a sua hostilidade aos navios.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Leaves the heavenly council to organize opposition on the African coast.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Deixa o conselho celestial para organizar a oposição na costa africana.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: In a local disguise, presses the ruler to ambush the watering party and mislead the fleet.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Disfarçado localmente, pressiona o governante para emboscar o grupo de rega e enganar a frota.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Accepts the plan for an attack on shore and a deceptive pilot.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Aceita o plano de ataque à costa e um piloto enganador.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Prepares three armed boats for water after the shore gives a hostile reply.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Prepara três barcos armados para a água depois de a costa dar uma resposta hostil.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Approaches the defended beach as the boat artillery opens fire.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Aproxima-se da praia defendida enquanto a artilharia do barco abre fogo.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Is with the landing force as Portuguese arms pursue defenders and attack the settlement.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Está com a força de desembarque enquanto as armas portuguesas perseguem os defensores e atacam a povoação.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Returns to the fleet with the watering party after the attack.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Regressa à frota com o grupo de rega após o ataque.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sends a peace proposal after his people have suffered the shore assault.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Envia uma proposta de paz depois de o seu povo ter sofrido o ataque à costa.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Rejects the peace offer and orders the fleet onward.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Rejeita a oferta de paz e ordena à frota que avance.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Boards as the pilot engaged for the next leg of the voyage.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Embarca enquanto o piloto se prepara para a próxima etapa da viagem.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Asks for the onward course and listens to the pilot’s misleading answer.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Pede o rumo seguinte e ouve a resposta enganadora do piloto.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Attempts to direct the ships toward a place chosen for their harm.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Tentativas de direcionar os navios para um local escolhido para o seu dano.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sends contrary winds to push the ships away from the false pilot’s course.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Envia ventos contrários para afastar os navios do rumo do falso piloto.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Hears the pilot claim that another island has Christian inhabitants.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ouve o piloto afirmar que outra ilha tem habitantes cristãos.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Substitutes a false description of a nearby island when his first course fails.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Substitui uma descrição falsa de uma ilha próxima quando o seu primeiro rumo falha.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sees Mombasa across the channel as the new proposed destination.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Vê Mombaça do outro lado do canal como o novo destino proposto.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Guides the approach to the city he has described deceptively.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Orienta a abordagem da cidade que ele descreveu enganosamente.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Waits outside Mombasa for the boats coming with the ruler’s message.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Espera fora de Mombaça pelos barcos que chegam com a mensagem do governante.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Remains with the fleet as the invitation he helped arrange arrives.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Permanece com a frota quando chega o convite que ajudou a organizar.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Considers an invitation to enter Mombasa while the ships lie outside the harbor.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Considera um convite para entrar em Mombaça enquanto os navios estão fora do porto.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Encourages the captain to trust the city’s welcome.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Incentiva o capitão a confiar nas boas-vindas da cidade.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sends envoys and gifts ashore to investigate the offered hospitality.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Envia enviados e presentes a terra para investigar a hospitalidade oferecida.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sets a false Christian sign before the visiting envoys inside Mombasa.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Coloca um falso sinal cristão diante dos enviados visitantes em Mombaça.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Hears the envoys’ report and prepares to accept the apparent welcome.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ouve o relatório dos enviados e prepara-se para aceitar as aparentes boas-vindas.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Has the captain’s renewed confidence as the ships prepare to move.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Tem a confiança renovada do capitão enquanto os navios se preparam para se deslocar.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Orders anchors raised for the entry into Mombasa’s harbor.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ordena que se levantem âncoras para a entrada no porto de Mombaça.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Steers the ships toward the prepared harbor trap.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Conduz os navios em direção à armadilha do porto preparada.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Calls the Nereids to hold the ships away from the dangerous entrance.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Chama as Nereidas para manter os navios afastados da entrada perigosa.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Places divine force against the flagship’s bow as it nears the harbor.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Coloca força divina contra a proa da nau capitânia à medida que esta se aproxima do porto.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Carries Venus across the sea toward the leading Portuguese ship.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Carrega Vénus através do mar em direção ao principal navio português.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Struggles with the crew as the flagship refuses the course into harbor.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Luta com a tripulação enquanto o navio-chefe recusa a rota para o porto.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sees the shore boats and pilot break away from the failed approach.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Vê os barcos costeiros e o piloto a desviarem-se da abordagem falhada.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Flees the fleet when the concealed plan fails.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Foge da frota quando o plano oculto falha.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Infers treachery from the sudden flight and prays for a safe route.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Infere traição pela fuga repentina e reza por um percurso seguro.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Takes the repeated dangers facing the ships to Jupiter in Olympus.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Leva os repetidos perigos enfrentados pelas naves até Júpiter no Olimpo.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives Venus’s plea for protection of the voyagers.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe o apelo de Vénus para proteção dos viajantes.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Offers Venus a consoling forecast of Portuguese deeds.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Oferece a Vénus uma previsão consoladora dos feitos portugueses.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Hears Jupiter’s assurances about the sailors she has defended.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ouve as garantias de Júpiter sobre os marinheiros que ela defendeu.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sends Mercury to make Melinde ready and warn the captain.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Envia Mercúrio preparar Melinde e avisar o capitão.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives the charge to prepare the port and reach Gama in a dream.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe a incumbência de preparar o porto e chegar em sonho ao Gama.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Flies toward Melinde and prepares the ruler for the fleet’s arrival.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Voa em direção a Melinde e prepara o governante para a chegada da frota.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Appears in Gama’s dream with an urgent warning to leave Mombasa.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Aparece no sonho de Gama com um aviso urgente para sair de Mombaça.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sleeps aboard, receives the warning, and wakes to order sail.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Dorme a bordo, recebe o aviso e acorda para ordenar a partida.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Orders the fleet away from Mombasa and questions boats met at sea.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ordena à frota que abandone Mombaça e questiona os barcos encontrados no mar.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Hears of Melinde as a possible source of a reliable India pilot and turns north.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ouve falar de Melinde como uma possível fonte de um piloto indiano de confiança e vira para norte.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Anchors near Melinde and sends notice of the Portuguese arrival.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ancora perto de Melinde e envia aviso da chegada portuguesa.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives notice of the fleet and sends a hospitable reply from shore.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe a notificação da frota e envia uma resposta hospitaleira a partir da costa.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Welcomes the messenger aboard and answers the ruler’s invitation.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Dá as boas-vindas ao mensageiro a bordo e responde ao convite do governante.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Hears the Portuguese envoy’s request for peaceful reception and assistance.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ouve o pedido do enviado português de recepção e assistência pacíficas.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Answers the shore’s ceremonial display from the ships at night.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Responde à exibição cerimonial da costa a partir dos navios, à noite.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives the Portuguese response amid the port’s evening celebration.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe a resposta portuguesa em plena celebração noturna do porto.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Embarks with attendants in an ornate boat to meet the captain.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Embarca com acompanhantes num barco ornamentado para encontrar o capitão.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Leaves the anchored fleet in a boat with his own company.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Deixa a frota ancorada em barco com companhia própria.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives the Melinde ruler aboard his boat and answers his offer of help.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe o governante Melinde a bordo do seu barco e responde à sua oferta de ajuda.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Joins Gama in the captain’s boat and extends his hospitality directly.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Junta-se a Gama no barco do capitão e estende diretamente a sua hospitalidade.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Listens to the ruler’s request and prepares to recount his homeland and route.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Ouve o pedido do governante e prepara-se para contar a sua terra natal e o seu percurso.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Asks Gama for the history of the people and ships now in his harbor.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Pergunta a Gama a história dos povos e dos navios que hoje estão no seu porto.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Begins to answer the Melinde ruler with an account of Portugal and its people.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Começa a responder ao governante Melinde com um relato de Portugal e do seu povo.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Listens at the harbor meeting as the captain begins the requested history.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Escuta na reunião do porto enquanto o capitão inicia a história solicitada.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Conducts campaigns in Spain that attract knights seeking military renown.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Realiza campanhas em Espanha que atraem cavaleiros em busca de renome militar.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Offers his daughter Teresa and Portuguese lands in marriage to Count Henrique.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Oferece a sua filha Teresa e terras portuguesas em casamento ao conde Henrique.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Accepts the marriage and territory that establish his position in Portugal.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Aceita o casamento e o território que estabelecem a sua posição em Portugal.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Enters the dynastic account as the daughter given in marriage to Henrique.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Entra na conta dinástica como a filha dada em casamento a Henrique.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Claims control of the lands left after Henrique’s death and challenges her son’s inheritance.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Reivindica o controlo das terras deixadas após a morte de Henrique e contesta a herança do filho.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Faces exclusion from the lands he expects to inherit after his father’s death.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Enfrenta a exclusão das terras que espera herdar após a morte do pai.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Resolves to contest his mother’s control of his ancestral lands.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Decide contestar o controlo da sua mãe sobre as suas terras ancestrais.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Holds the lands with her husband while her son prepares to challenge that rule.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Mantém as terras com o marido enquanto o filho se prepara para desafiar esta regra.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Is surrounded at Guimarães by a larger hostile force.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Está cercado em Guimarães por uma força hostil maior.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Pledges himself to secure relief for the besieged prince.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Compromete-se a garantir o alívio para o príncipe sitiado.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Comes barefoot before the king with his family to answer for his unfulfilled pledge.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Vai descalço diante do rei com a sua família para responder pela sua promessa não cumprida.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Accompanies her husband and children as he offers their lives for his word.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Acompanha o marido e os filhos enquanto ele oferece as suas vidas pela sua palavra.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives Egas and his family as the pledge comes due.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe Egas e a sua família no vencimento do penhor.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sets his smaller army opposite a much larger force at Ourique.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Coloca o seu exército mais pequeno em oposição a uma força muito maior em Ourique.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Faces five opposing kings on the field, with his force still outnumbered.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Enfrenta cinco reis adversários em campo, com a sua força ainda em menor número.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Is named as the foremost of the opposing kings assembled at Ourique.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: É apontado como o principal dos reis adversários reunidos em Ourique.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Sees the figure on the cross at dawn and answers with an appeal for aid against the enemy.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Vê a figura na cruz de madrugada e responde com um apelo de ajuda contra o inimigo.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Appears to Afonso on the cross in the battle vision recounted by Gama.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Aparece a Afonso na cruz na visão de batalha contada por Gama.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Receives the army’s acclamation as king before the impending charge.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Recebe a aclamação do exército como rei antes do ataque iminente.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Remains with the opposing force as the Portuguese prepare to engage.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Permanece com a força adversária enquanto os portugueses se preparam para o combate.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Leads the Portuguese side into the clash at Ourique.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Conduz a equipa portuguesa ao embate em Ourique.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Commands the opposing side while the poem describes combat and casualties.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Comanda o lado oposto enquanto o poema descreve combates e baixas.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Remains on the won field for three days and marks his shield with five shields.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Permanece no campo conquistado durante três dias e marca o seu escudo com cinco escudos.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Moves from Ourique to take Leiria and nearby strongholds.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Muda-se de Ourique para tomar Leiria e redutos próximos.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Joins a northern fleet in putting Lisbon under a prolonged siege.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Junta-se a uma frota do Norte para colocar Lisboa sob um cerco prolongado.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Extends the campaign to the towns around Lisbon and beyond the Tagus.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: Alarga a campanha às localidades lisboetas e além-Tejo.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Is credited with taking Évora through daring in the campaign.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: É creditado por ter levado Évora através da ousadia na campanha.

characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.source: Takes Beja, where the poem describes killings after the city yields.
characterSnapshots/os-lusiadas-snapshot-.pt: É o caso de Beja, onde o poema descreve assassinatos depois de a cidade ter cedido.
